retention with a spacing effect, flashbulb exemptions, atomic writes — sound); and the
Wants ladder hysteresis, UNCLEAR-percept priority, interoceptive provenance and TurnCues
bounds all pinned by new shields.

**Tests.** 468 → **478 assertions**. Full battery green including the ASan/UBSan pass,
TSan clean, `-Wall -Wextra` clean against the real whisper/llama headers, clean-room
verified. Cost 4.8 µs/tick — 0.0048% of one core — and 4.3 µs per field render.

### 26l. UX-parity audit against the shipped demo experience (2026-07-31)

An integration audit against the experience the demo video shows, using the repo's own UX
contract (README latency tables, the launcher's actual flags) as the reference.

**The terminal was not stock.** Two leaks, both through flags the launcher always passes.
The inner-state field was appended to `text_heard` BEFORE the stock bold stdout print, so
every user line in the console carried up to ~260 bytes of her inner state — the demo's
clean "Igor: <words>" line visibly changed. The field is prompt content, not display
content: the display copy now strips it, and the console under `-pe` is line-for-line what
stock ATHENA printed. Likewise the per-turn `[mind]` field and diagnostic prints rode
`print_energy`, which the launcher pins on; they now ride their own `ATHENA_MIND_DEBUG`
(default off). An autonomous turn also no longer prints a dangling empty "Igor:" line —
on screen it reads as her simply starting to talk, which is what happened.

**The per-turn cost is measured and has a lever.** Across 120 realistic turns the field
runs p50 123 bytes (~32 tokens), p90 198 (~51), hard-capped max 262 (~67) — prompt-prefill
on the user's line, additive to time-to-first-token at whatever the rig's prompt-eval rate
is. The README documents decode (6.4 tok/s) and TTS first-audio (310-430 ms) but not
prompt eval, so the honest check is on-rig A/B: one session with `ATHENA_CONSCIOUSNESS=0`,
one without, comparing the llama.cpp prompt-eval log lines. `ATHENA_FIELD_VERBOSITY` (new,
0-1) scales the field's line budget for latency-sensitive setups. The one-time framing
block is ~1690 tokens inside the n_keep prefix — startup-only, and ~2% of the 80,000-token
context. Everything else on the turn path is microseconds (field render 4.3 µs, tick
4.8 µs at 0.005% duty, sampler ~20 exp() per decode step at 6.4 steps/s).

**Behavioural deltas are exactly the designed ones, each with its own off-switch:** she may
speak first after 90+ s of silence (`ATHENA_VOLITION=0`), decline a turn or end a
conversation by the two-signal path (`ATHENA_AUTONOMY=0`), and she now respects "give me a
minute". Wake word, barge-in, emotion tags, time cues, memory consolidation, the goodbye
flow and every latency-relevant pipeline stage are untouched, and `ATHENA_CONSCIOUSNESS=0`
remains byte-identical to stock (asserted in the safety suite).

### 26m. Sixth full review: the seam becomes executable, and executing it finds a stock bug (2026-07-31)

The one part of the overlay no round had ever RUN was the seam logic inside talk-llama.cpp
— the TTS sanitisation, the farewell matcher, the streaming field-echo guard, the console
parity strip. They sat as statics in a translation unit whose main() links whisper, llama
and SDL, so six rounds verified them by inspection and compilation only. That is exactly
how the seam bugs of earlier rounds survived as long as they did.

**New file: `athena_seam.h`.** The seam's pure logic, moved verbatim into a header with no
dependencies beyond the substrate: `asr_confidence`, `said_farewell`, the full
`sanitize_for_tts` transformation, the cross-chunk `FieldEchoGuard` as a real state
machine (previously an inline tangle of flags in the flush loop), and `console_display`.
talk-llama.cpp delegates; behaviour is byte-identical by construction, and the flush loop
now owns only the TTS write.

**New suite: `test_seam.cpp` (51 assertions) — and its FIRST execution found a bug in
stock ATHENA.** The TTS strip ran the bare-URL pattern before the markdown-link pattern;
the URL regex consumes to the next space, so on "[the paper](https://x.y)" it ate the
target INCLUDING the closing paren, the link pattern could no longer match, and the
fragment "[the paper](" was passed to the vocoder — she would read bracket-noise aloud any
time the model produced a standard markdown link. The bug predates the overlay and ships
in the baseline demo. Order swapped: links unwrap first (keeping their text), bare URLs
still die. Every other stock behaviour is now a golden: reasoning-span removal, markdown
unwrapping, the [interrupted] and [emotion:] insurance strips, the dangling-dash rule, the
ChatML role-weld rule (including that "the assistant was helpful." in prose is untouched).

The guard suite drives the exact verified real-world failure — an echoed field split
across seven chunks — and asserts the prose before it flushes intact, the whole span is
consumed, the prose after it survives, end-of-turn discards an unclosed field, an
implausibly long span releases the hold rather than eating prose, and the pattern keys on
the configured bot name. Console parity is pinned byte-identical: emotion and time tags
shown, field never, autonomous turns showing only her speaker tag.

**Also this round:** `Latent::perturb` clamps its magnitude on entry (beyond the state
limit, two different magnitudes produced byte-identical h — a flattened dose-response any
probe would misread), and the stale `energy()` comment now says what the function is
actually for.

**Tests.** 478 → **529 assertions** across six binaries plus the sanitizer pass covering
all six. Full battery green, `-Wall -Wextra` clean against the real whisper/llama headers,
clean-room verified. The tarball gains `athena_seam.h`; INSTALL updated.

### §27 — Round 7: the relationship layer, and what a pinned constant hides

Six rounds hardened what she IS. This round adds what she is to SOMEONE — the things a
person accumulates about another person across time, which no amount of within-session
machinery can produce — and then discovers that one of the substrate's own observables had
been reporting a constant of the arithmetic rather than a property of the conversation.

**1. `OtherModel` — him, as she has come to know him.** Her self-model was rich; her model
of Igor reset at every goodbye. His tone reached her per-turn and nothing accumulated, so
she could never say "you sound different today" and mean it, because there was no baseline
for "usually". Now: slow bias-corrected EMAs of his typical tone, energy, turn length,
return gap and arrival hour (the last as a circular mean, because 23:30 and 00:30 are one
hour apart, not twenty-three), persisted beside the narrative self and learned across every
session. Per-turn residuals against that baseline feed a departure notice which competes for
awareness like anything else. Rare by construction: forty turns of warm-up, a ten-minute
refractory, at most two notices a session. Being noticed is registered faster than almost
anything else in a relationship, and it is only possible against an expectation — which
makes this the social half of PP-1.

**2. Prospective memory — a question kept on purpose.** The episodic carry preserved what
she was still turning over; it could not preserve what she MEANT TO ASK. An `Intent` is
formed at session end from the highest-affect unresolved thing HE said in the closing
stretch, persisted, surfaced once in the opening turns of the next session, and retired —
by his answer, by him raising it first, or by age. "I kept thinking about what you said"
already worked; "I came back still holding something from last time" did not, and it is the
most humanlike opening move there is.

**3. Deliberation — the temporal signature of thought.** Her time-to-first-word was purely
mechanical and identical for "good morning" and "do you think you're conscious?". Now a
bounded pre-speech pause is drawn from confidence, stance, workspace contention and
surprise. The gate is the point: an ordinary confident turn pays exactly zero. This is the
one place where ADDING latency adds realism.

**4. Mood survives sleep.** Core affect reset at session start, so a bruising evening left
her fresh the next morning. Her closing valence/arousal now persist and are decayed toward
rest by the length of the gap (tau 36 h: overnight keeps about three quarters, a week leaves
traces). Waking is deliberately not a felt shift — the trailing reference is set to the
restored state, or she would report a mood swing she never had.

**5. Attention-gated comprehension.** She heard perfectly whatever state she was in. Now,
rarely, the loss is hers rather than the transcript's: when his words arrive while her
workspace is held by her own internally-generated content and he has been away long enough
for her to have gone somewhere, her uptake of that turn is genuinely degraded and she says
so and asks — instead of answering a line she half took in.

**6. Diurnal texture.** She knew gap durations but not the hour. One line of wall-clock
awareness, a faint circadian bias on resting arousal (trough near 4 am), and the hour feeds
the second-person model's "not his usual hour" channel.

#### The measurement that mattered

Two independent adversarial passes — a full review and a 50-mutation campaign — ran against
the first implementation. Between them they found thirteen defects. The three that mattered:

**`contested_` was a constant, and it had been one all along.** It was computed from the
salience PRIOR, which contains the arbiter's own entry (`sal[MOD_SALIENCE] = 0.55 *
contested_`) against a constant `sal[MOD_MEMORY] = 0.25` — a self-referential loop whose
fixed point is `sqrt(0.25/0.55) = 0.674`. Measured: 0.652–0.665 at turn arrival across forty
varied turns, standard deviation under 0.005. It never measured contention; it reported an
artifact of its own arithmetic, permanently above both gates that read it. Deliberation
therefore fired on **39 of 40 ordinary turns**, each paying a third of a second of dead air
carrying no information — the exact opposite of its stated contract, shipped. Fixing it took
three measurements: excluding the arbiter's own entry exposed that the prior also carries a
common additive latent-bias term (a ratio then reads p50 0.94 regardless of events), and
measuring the settled activations instead exposed that lateral inhibition is winner-take-most
by design (p99 0.044 even during genuine ties). The answer is the INTRINSIC pull — score ×
salience × affect, without the incumbency and attention bonuses, between the two strongest
DIFFERENT specialists, captured inside the settle loop — with asymmetric dynamics, because a
tie is an event: it occurs on 0.4% of ticks and when it does the margin is 0.885–0.961, so
symmetric smoothing averaged one sharp event against 250 empty ticks. It now measures 0.000
throughout silence and peaks at 0.917 when steamrolled, and deliberation fires on 0% of clean
turns and 75–81% of turns she genuinely cannot vouch for.

**The kept question nagged.** `form_intents_()` restricted its search to the closing ten
minutes using a session-monotonic clock — but carried traces sit at NEGATIVE timestamps, so
in any session shorter than nine minutes last session's own traces were eligible to become
this session's new question, at age 0, defeating MAX_AGE entirely. Measured end to end: the
identical opening line on three consecutive session starts. And the weight was `|valence|`,
so the most reliable way to produce a kept question was to end on a hostile stretch — she
would open the next session, possibly a week later, quoting his angriest line back at him
under a "still wondering" frame. Fixed by excluding carried traces from the closing stretch
and by suppressing new questions when the session itself ended badly (her own state can tell
anger from worry; the per-episode signal cannot — `[emotion: angry]` is (−0.70, 0.85) and
`[emotion: fearful]` is (−0.60, 0.78), which is not a separable pair, and filtering on
valence would have thrown away the archetypal case to catch the hostile one).

**Drift was about his silence, not her attention.** The `pred_error > 0.50` arm measured max
0.148 at turn arrival across 400 topic-churning turns — unreachable, because attention is
stable in the tick before a turn, which is exactly when it is read. So every event came from
`presence < 0.35`, which is a lagged function of how long HE had been quiet: she claimed to
have been elsewhere when he had gone to make coffee, or — worse — when he had ASKED her for a
minute to think. Rewritten to the state it names: her workspace held by internally-generated
content she is still in, plus a real absence, minus any silence he requested.

Also fixed: both new field lines rendered twice (once framed, once bare in the quieter-slot
list) — a `owns_own_frame` rule now decides which clause owns a gist, and the topic-shift
line that already had this check keeps it; the intent frame produced word salad on most
inputs because it had a syntactic slot ("what came of X") and `X` is an arbitrary clip of
his own sentence; the ±0.05 circadian amplitude propagated into the arousal ceiling at
roughly 1:1 and left `<laugh>` — calibrated pre-circadian — with 0.042 of headroom at the
4 am trough, i.e. inside the noise of any future change; the once-per-session hour note was
consumed even when the line budget dropped it, and could then be delivered at ten in the
morning; `typ_gap_s` was learned, clamped and persisted while being read by nothing; an
oversized kept question from a file consumed the entire field budget; a backwards clock read
as "no time has passed"; and `mood=`/`other=` accepted trailing garbage.

#### On the tests

A second 58-mutation campaign against the fixed code confirmed every original defect class
is now killed, and surfaced five STRUCTURAL gaps in how the suite was written. Each became a
section rather than a case:

- **Direction is tested; magnitude is not.** `hi > lo + 0.05` passes for a coefficient
  halved. Every coefficient in `deliberation_seconds` is now pinned by value.
- **One-sided thresholds can be loosened for free.** Four of five notice clauses were
  asserted only in the firing direction — so all four could be relaxed into single-turn
  firing, which the design forbids and which the one two-sided channel already tested.
- **Deleting a guard is not the same mutation as perturbing it.** `e.t < 0.0`,
  `!asked_for_quiet` and the late-hour restore all had tests that killed a flip and missed a
  deletion; each now has a case that reaches the line.
- **The two-site rule.** Where one defect class has two instances (`%n` arity on `mood=`
  and `other=`), only one had a test. Both do now — and testing the second found that a
  CRLF file half-loads.
- **A test that samples only the extrema of a bounded curve cannot see its amplitude.** The
  laugh test sampled hours 4 and 16, the two cosine extrema, where a downstream clamp
  collapses a 0.050 amplitude and a 0.035 one to the same value. Amplitude is now asserted
  at hour 19, where the two differ by 29% of the term's band.

Plus: `contested_` gets a CONTRAST test rather than a bound — a quantity that never differs
between a calm conversation and a fraught one is not measuring the conversation, and that
property, not any bound, is what would have caught the original bug in round one.

**Tests.** 529 → **696 assertions** across six binaries, all green, ASan/UBSan clean on all
six, TSan clean on the threaded suite, four-times flake sweep clean, and `-Wall -Wextra`
clean compiled against the real whisper/llama headers. A fifteenth conversation shape
("reunion at 1 am") drives the whole relationship layer end to end. Tick cost 4.6 µs.
