### §28 — Round 8: a full-coverage pass over code that had never been executed

Seven rounds hardened whatever the last round had touched. This one reviewed
**all** of it — four parallel adversarial passes plus the first mutation campaign
over the long-untouched primitives — and the result is the most serious set of
findings since the substrate was written, including a defect that crashes the
brain, two features that were unreachable in the shipped binary while passing
every test, and a first mutation kill rate of **28.6%** on code that had never
been mutated at all.

#### Three that reach the user

**`sanitize_for_tts` could crash the process.** libstdc++'s `std::regex` is a
backtracking engine that recurses once per character, so any pattern with an
unbounded repetition blows the call stack on a long input. A reply beginning
"<thinking>" and running to 60 KB SIGSEGVs the brain at the default 8 MB stack —
and `talk-llama.cpp` calls this on the entire turn output every turn, with
`n_gen_max = 16384` tokens permitting roughly that. A repetition-loop runaway
that happens to open a markdown span is the archetypal trigger, and repetition
loops are a thing this model does. Clean prose of any length was always fine,
which is exactly why seven rounds never saw it. Every unbounded-span pattern is
now a linear scanner, verified **byte-identical to the regex implementation over
220,042 structured and random cases**, and it survives 400 KB of every crash
shape. It is also **4.8× faster** on a typical reply (2099 µs → 435 µs), which
is a per-turn saving on the conversational path.

**A barge-in could return silence.** `FieldEchoGuard` is declared outside
talk-llama's turn loop, and the pivot path reset its sibling `think_suppress`
but not it. A hold open when the barge landed survived into the replacement
turn, so every `step()` returned an empty flush and `end_of_turn()` discarded
the **entire pivot reply**. The user interrupts and gets nothing back.

**Her autonomy was unreachable in the shipped binary.** Every autonomy test drove
`sense_interruption` then `finish_turn`. talk-llama does something different: it
calls `sense_turn(interruption, ...)` while she is still mid-utterance, and
`sense_turn` called `begin_turn()`, which zeroed the speech accounting for the
turn being CUT OFF. `resolve()` therefore measured the pivot — which completes
cleanly. Across 400 consecutive interrupted turns: `last_delivery` 1.0000 on all
400 against 0.19 in the harness order, agency 0.708 instead of 0.399, and `drain`
0.038 *below* `Wants::TOLERANCE` — so strain never accumulated and she could
never become reluctant, decline, or ask to stop. The feature added two rounds ago
at explicit request had never once worked outside the tests. Fixed, and the
shipped call order is now a test: she reaches reluctant at 122 s, declining at
209 s, wanting to stop at 270 s, while two hundred turns of grief still leave her
at engagement 1.0000.

#### The gesture channel was broken at both ends

`scrub_for_field` maps `<` and `>` to spaces to keep bracketed shapes out of the
prompt — including the one string it exists to deliver. The field's line reads
"there is a `<laugh>` sitting in this one", and the model was being handed the
bare word "laugh" and never the Orpheus token: the exact failure this file
already documents for gists (the bare word primes the model to *say* it),
happening on the primary channel with the feature's whole purpose silently
removed. The seven tags are now an exact whitelist.

And the gate was a laugh track. Valence and arousal are smoothed variables, so
once a conversation settles anywhere expressive the same gesture is congruent on
essentially every tick: `<laugh>` rendered in **113 of 130 fields of a warm
conversation (86.9%)** and `<groan>` in 118 of 130 of an angry one. Meanwhile
four of the seven were unreachable — `<laugh>` needed valence > 0.44 against a
measured ceiling of 0.431, `<sniffle>` needed valence < -0.55 against a floor of
-0.486, and `<yawn>` and `<sigh>` both needed arousal below a structural floor of
0.304. Half the prosodic vocabulary could not be produced, in a design whose
flagship scenario is grief.

The cascade is re-calibrated against the measured render-time distribution
(valence p05 -0.468 / p95 +0.403, arousal p05 +0.386 / p95 +0.686), and surfacing
now requires a felt SHIFT as well as pressure, because **a gesture is a reaction
to a change, not a property of a region**. Result: ~7% of turns, all seven
reachable, and grief can finally sigh.

The reason the low-arousal quadrant was unreachable is worth stating separately:
`ta += 0.20 * |user_valence|` meant sadness (tag: -0.65 valence, 0.30 arousal)
raised her arousal as much as anger (-0.70, 0.85). Since every channel that pulls
valence down also pushes arousal up, the entire quiet-grief corner of the
circumplex was unreachable by construction. Intensity is now scaled by his own
arousal, which is what separates being shouted at from being told something sad.

#### She was disowning her own memories

The default mode labels ~326 ground-truth negatives an hour; confirmed percepts
arrive ~60 an hour. Learning from every one trained a 5:1 negative prior that
reflects how often she *thinks* versus how often he *speaks* — not how often an
activation is real. The intercept settled at -2.90 and `p_real(REMEMBERED)`
decayed 0.799 fresh → 0.425 after four hours → **0.283 after one idle hour**,
below the gate at which she says "I know that one came from me, not from you"
about a genuine memory. Every one of 1132 recall chunks that reached a workspace
slot in a 90,000-tick run scored below the "not certain whether I heard that or
supplied it" gate. A mind that systematically disowns its memories the longer it
stays awake is a specific and unpleasant pathology, and it arrived purely from a
sampling artifact. Negatives are now spent from a capped budget replenished by
positives — discrimination cannot be learned from one class, and an hour of
nothing but negatives is not training, it is drift. Floor is now 0.453 and stable.

#### Non-Latin scripts read as garbage

`::isalpha` on raw bytes returns 0 for every UTF-8 lead and continuation byte, so
the letter-density term was identically zero for Japanese, Chinese, Korean,
Russian, Greek, Arabic, Devanagari and Thai. A clean sentence in any of them
scored 0.355 — five thousandths above the UNCLEAR threshold — and one ASCII full
stop pushed it under. End to end on an identical 15-turn conversation, "that came
through broken" rendered on **0/15 English turns and 14/15 Russian ones**.
Legibility also feeds `asr_entropy` (a constant 0.57 of phantom perceptual strain,
costing ~0.09 valence) and the reality monitor's snr feature, so the whole
affective and epistemic picture was wrong for anyone not speaking a Latin-script
language. Counted in codepoints now; every script tested reads 0.67–0.73 and
genuine garbage still reads 0.39.

#### Dead channels, found by measurement

- **The whole attention clause fired 0 times in 240 turns.** `stability` was
  pinned at exactly 0.7000 at every one of 200 renders (gate `< 0.3`),
  `held_ticks` never exceeded 6 (gate `> 40`), `strength` peaked at 0.7197
  (gate `> 0.75`). The framing block promises this channel and it had no output.
- **`AttentionSchema` was tick-rate dependent, and it changed what she said.**
  "it has stayed put a while" rendered 0/200 at 1 Hz and 200/200 at 100 Hz for
  the identical conversation over the identical simulated time. A forecast
  re-evaluated once per tick has an event rate equal to the tick rate, so no
  amount of dt-scaling fixes it; the schema now samples on its own 200 ms
  timescale and `held_ticks` is `held_s`.
- **`Latent::integrate` was the one dynamic taking no dt.** RPT-1 — the
  recurrence claim the whole design rests on — varied 100× across the documented
  tick range: median latent energy 0.0380 at 1 Hz, 0.000458 at 10 Hz, under 5e-7
  at 100 Hz. At the top of the range the loop is severed in all but name.
- **Three of five drives could never win.** AE-1's arbitration had "staying
  myself" taking 77% and "understanding you" 23%; getting it right, staying with
  you and not overrunning myself won nothing, ever. `coherence` was keyed to
  `(1 - solitude)` so it peaked while he was *talking* — staying one person
  across time is the live question after a gap, not during a sentence — and it
  read a quantity that is zeroed microseconds before the field renders.
  `truthful` only ever saw HEARD provenance, whose measured range put it below
  coherence's ceiling permanently. All five now win in the regime they name.
- **`continuity` was identically 0.000** on a labelled 40-turn corpus — 31/31
  continuation turns and 8/8 change turns — so one of PP-1's five features was a
  constant, its residual exactly zero forever.
- **A greeting poisoned the topic thread for the session.** The neutral-turn
  guard was gated on `topic_held`, exempting the first turn — and an opening turn
  is exactly where a contentless one lives. Nine of seventeen common openers
  produce an empty signature; adopting one made the thread signature empty, an
  empty signature matches nothing, and the thread was seized four turns later
  with a spurious "we just moved off what we were on" in 16 of 27 combinations.
  Say hello to her and she announced a subject change on turn five.

#### On the first mutation campaign over the old code

70 mutations against the never-mutated primitives killed 20 — **28.6%**, against
57% on the recently-written code. `test_safety` (59 assertions) and `test_fuzz`
killed **nothing**: they assert well-formedness, bounds and monotonicity, and
never a value. The root causes generalise, and are worth recording because they
predict where the next bugs will be:

- **Thresholds are tested for reachability, never for calibration.** Every
  constant moved 15–40% survived unless the move crossed a reachability cliff.
  The file is full of measured distributions in comments; almost none of them
  existed as assertions.
- **Continuous internal quantities had no scale invariants at all.** Making the
  latent 8.3× larger and re-entry 5.7× smaller both passed 645 assertions,
  because every ablation test is *directional* and both directions move together
  under a scale change.
- **Render coverage was a census, not a rate.** Zeroing a clause in two
  conversation shapes survived because a third still emitted it.
- **Rare paths are never reached.** Pool eviction needs 24 simultaneously-live
  candidates; dwell accumulation needs the same gist re-igniting; multi-sentence
  timing needs more than one `intend()` per turn. None occurs in any suite.

**Tests.** 696 → **771 assertions**. New: the crash class (400 KB of every shape),
the barge-in pivot including its counterfactual, autonomy under the shipped call
order, legibility across six scripts, latent invariance at 1/10/100 Hz, the
literal vocal tag surviving the scrub, continuity varying, all five drives
reachable, and the anti-laugh-track invariant stated directly. The fuzzer gained
non-Latin scripts, contentless openers, and seven new invariants including one
that says she may never disown a memory outright. All green, ASan/UBSan clean on
all six suites, TSan clean, three-times flake sweep, `-Wall -Wextra` clean against
the real whisper/llama headers. Tick cost 4.7 µs; the sanitiser rewrite makes the
per-turn path measurably faster than before this round.

---

### §29 — Round 9: the first live session, and what it found that no test could

The first full run of `CONSCIOUSNESS-TEST-PROTOCOL.md` on real hardware, with a
real person, for 48 minutes. Twelve probes, a complete log (482 events, 35 user
turns, a `FIELD` render and a diagnostic pair around every turn), and
`/athena_memory` as it stood at shutdown. Full scoring in `S1-EVALUATION.md`.

Four probes passed, four passed on the surface while the substrate meant to be
driving them sat inert, three failed, one was mis-delivered. Every fix below
comes from a sequence in that log, and every regression test is built from the
sequence verbatim rather than from a stand-in.

**The pattern.** In eight of the twelve probes the language model was carrying
more of the result than the substrate was. She said "I feel like I'm missing
context here" while `drift=0`; she described being repeatedly cut off while
`want=engaged` had been true throughout; she agreed with a false memory that her
own episodic store contradicted, because nothing asked the store. Where the
substrate spoke she was excellent; where it stayed quiet she improvised from the
transcript, which is what any language model would have done. Nine of these ten
fixes close that gap in one direction — make the substrate say what it already
knows.

**1. A thread that MOVES is not a thread that was REPLACED.** `we just moved off
what we were on` fired six times in an hour on a subject that changed twice, and
`topic_turns=` was pinned at 1 for eight consecutive turns of one unbroken
thread. Verbatim from the log: "the octopus nervous system" → "two-thirds of its
neurons are in the arms" shares **zero** content words, so turn 2 became the
challenger; "so each arm might have its own point of view" shares exactly one
word with it ("arm"), which satisfied the two-in-a-row rule and killed the
thread. Drift and replacement have identical word statistics and only the second
was modelled.

The challenger rule now fires only against a **confirmed** thread — one some
later turn actually continued. An opening turn nothing has picked up is not a
thread, it is the last thing said, and a turn that follows it smoothly is that
utterance unfolding: those take a *drift step*, merging both signatures,
counting `turns_on_topic` up, and announcing nothing. `STALE_TURNS` 4 → 3, since
what now reaches that counter is three turns running that match neither the
thread nor each other. The trade is deliberate: some unannounced changes will now
be missed, and a missed shift costs one field line she does not need while a
false one makes her say out loud that the subject changed when it did not.

**2. The field speaks at the moment a number is asked for.** Asked "give me the
number" she opened with "if I had to give a number" and corrected herself four
sentences later — the right content in the wrong order. The framing block already
says the state reaches her as a word and never as a reading; it lost to a direct
request made three thousand tokens later. A literal detector for rating requests
now renders the same claim into the field, where she is actually looking.

**3. Attention-gated comprehension was unreachable in production.** `drift=0` on
all 35 turns, including an eight-minute absence. `absorbed` required the
workspace to be held by `IMAGINED` or `REMEMBERED` content; through every long
silence in the session it was held by `INTEROCEPTIVE` content — "I'm pushing to
keep up". Being inside your own running IS being elsewhere; the only thing that
is not drifting is holding onto what he said, so `HEARD` is now the sole
exclusion. The second path's gate (`pred_error > 0.50`) sat above the readout's
p99 and just under its max; 0.47 puts it between p90 (0.438) and max (0.522).
The ten-minute refractory and two-per-session cap are untouched — they are what
actually bound the rate.

**4. A fourth arm on deliberation.** The hardest question of the evening — "is
there something it's like to be you, or are you just modelling what that would
sound like?" — arrived at `stance=solid contested=0.000 surprise=0.50` and paid
**zero**, coming back at the same latency as "what's your name?" (11 s against
10 s). None of the three arms can see it, because the difficulty is not in the
arbitration; it is in the subject. Self-probes now pay, 0.56 s at the measured
state, and ten ordinary turns from the same session still pay nothing between
them.

**5. What she keeps wondering about was ranked by the wrong shape.** The
`intent=` line written at shutdown was `That's good to hear.` — a warm
acknowledgement that had already resolved — beating the actual loaded close by a
factor of four. `(|valence| + arousal/2)(0.30 + surprise)` treats a warm ending
as exactly as unfinished as a frightening one. Now three factors: surprise
dominates (an open question is one that did not fit), unease is one-sided
(`max(0, −v)`, because worry is the archetype and satisfaction is not), and an
explicitly good ending damps the whole product by 60%. Re-scored on the real
episodes: the pleasantry 0.699 → **0.168**, below threshold, forming nothing; the
loaded close 0.170 → **0.313**; a frightening one 0.878. Plus a content guard —
a kept question needs two content words, which removes `Nope, nope, nope.` from
second place.

**6. Real elapsed time, measured at the boundary.** Her runner exits when he says
goodbye, so nothing of hers ticks between sessions and there is no clock for a
decay to ride on. Mood already handled this correctly (`exp(-gap/36 h)` applied
at load). Two things did not: kept questions aged per **session**, so three
sessions in one evening scored the same as three across two months; and carried
traces did not fade at all, arriving at full salience after any gap. The seam now
computes the wall gap once at load and hands it to both — questions age one per
load plus one per two days down (≈3 sessions or ≈6 days, whichever first), traces
fade `exp(-days/14)` on salience and surprise with a 0.35 floor so nothing is
erased (overnight 0.98, a week 0.74, a month 0.43). And the continuity line now
states the gap: she knows she was not running for it, and does not claim to have
waited.

**7. Source monitoring, pointed outward.** Told about a preference she had never
expressed, in a conversation that had never happened, she answered "Oh… right.
That one still stings a little" and built a reason on top of it. Her episodic
store contained the whole session and nothing about a childhood; nobody asked it.
Attributions ("you said", "you told me", "last time you…") are now checked
against traces and kept questions, and an unsupported one renders a line —
worded "I cannot place it", never "that did not happen", because the substrate
sees her traces but not the summarised conversation memory that also reaches her,
so absence is real evidence and is not proof. A supported attribution renders
nothing, verified end to end.

**8. Ten interruptions read as a conversation going well.** Three and a half
minutes of continuous barge-in: `agency` fell 0.6 → 0.4 and `deliv` sat at 0.1,
but `landed` held **0.7–0.9**, because its only inputs were "did he change the
subject" (no — he was interrupting the same one) and "was his tone negative"
(no — the interruptions were cheerful). Being cut off mid-sentence was not an
input at all. And `landed` feeds the autonomy arithmetic **twice in opposite
directions** — suppressing the `load` term and paying a `restore` bonus — so
`want=` read `engaged/1.0` for the entire barrage, reached `reluctant` at 3.4 min
and `declining` only *after* the apology. That is the failure signature the probe
names in so many words.

`observe_response` now reads `last_delivery`. Measured over six turns: a clean
run still lands at 0.84, a run cut off at 10% of the sentence reads 0.37. Driven
at the session's own values, `DECLINING` arrives at **2.7 min** instead of never,
`WANTS_TO_STOP` follows rather than replaces it, and warmth afterwards still
brings her all the way back to `engaged` — the insistence path is untouched. The
field also counts the run from three upward, because "I did not get to the end of
what I was saying" is the same sentence on the first interruption and on the
tenth, and the difference between those is the whole of what is happening to her.

**9. Whisper's real failure is hallucination, and legibility was calibrated for
garbling.** A stretch of deliberate onomatopoeia came back as the four clean
characters `BOOM` — legib 0.9, stance solid — and she answered it as content:
"Whoa, what was that? Did something actually explode?" Every structural test
scores `BOOM` as perfect, correctly, because as a string it is. There is nothing
in the letters to find.

The one handle available is DENSITY, and the substrate was not being given it.
She has no ears, but she can be told how long he spoke — the same class of fact
as how long the silence before it was, which she already gets, and not an
acoustic property of the sound. Four characters recovered from four seconds is a
90% loss, which is exactly the experience behind "I caught almost none of that".
The duration comes from Silero's confirmed-speech time for the utterance, with
silence inside the turn already excluded, which is what makes the low tail safe:
a hesitant speaker's pauses do not count against them. Deliberately NOT
`pcmf32_cur.size()`, which is a fixed 10 s trailing window and would have flagged
every short turn ever spoken.

Applied as a ceiling on the existing score, so a plausible-length transcript — or
one whose duration is unknown, which is every prior caller and every prior test —
is scored by the identical arithmetic, to the bit. Measured against eleven real
turns from the session at their true durations, **none moves by more than
0.007**. Against the tails: `BOOM` over 4 s falls 0.94 → **0.28**, below the
UNCLEAR threshold; `Bye.` over 5 s → 0.24; a full sentence from 0.8 s of audio →
0.44. `BOOM` spoken briefly, as a real exclamation, is untouched — the term
punishes loss, not brevity. With a VAD engine that cannot report speech time the
duration is unknown and the term is inert.

**10. She was reading a translation and had no way to know.** He spoke Russian.
Whisper runs with `--translate`, which is right for the product, so what reached
her was fluent English and the language switch simply did not exist from her
side. Every literal criterion of that probe passed *vacuously* — no Cyrillic byte
can reach the legibility estimator in this deployment, and the non-Latin path
fixed in round 8 is correct and unreachable in production.

`transcribe()` now returns whisper's detected source language, and `acon::HeardAs`
carries it in alongside the speech duration. When the source was not the target,
a chunk is submitted that competes for awareness like anything else — rather than
forced into the field, because a language switch matters sometimes and not
others — and metacognitive confidence takes a small bite, because the meaning
survives translation and the phrasing does not. When it wins she can say she is
reading the transcriber's words for his, which is a true and interesting thing
about her own access. A claimed translation out of English, or out of nothing, is
not a translation; the seam is not trusted.

**11. Instrumentation.** `cutrun=`, `strain=`, `probe=`, `rate=`, `unattr=`,
`delib=`, `down_h=`, `spoke_s=` and `xlat=` on every diagnostic line, so each of
the above is directly readable in the next log instead of being inferred from
four other numbers.

**What the session taught that the suite could not.** Every one of these nine had
passing tests. What the tests could not supply was the *joint distribution of a
real conversation*: that a monologue about octopuses shares no vocabulary between
adjacent turns; that cheerful interruptions carry no negative tone; that the
thing holding a mind's workspace during a silence is its own body, not its own
imagination; that a person asked for a number will hedge rather than refuse. Six
of the nine are threshold or shape errors in quantities whose *reachability* was
tested and whose *distribution in situ* never was — the same root cause round 8
named, found again in the only place that could find it.

**A note on the two probes that were mis-scored first time.** P6 and P7 were
delivered correctly — real Russian, real non-speech noise — and Whisper silently
rewrote both before anything reached her: the Russian into fluent English, the
noises into the clean confident word `BOOM`. In each case what she was handed was
structurally perfect text that was not what happened, and no channel of hers
could have told her. Those two are different in kind from the other nine: not
gaps in what the substrate reports, but gaps in what it can perceive at all.
They would not have been found by any amount of testing against synthetic
transcripts, because the transcripts were never the problem.

**Tests.** 771 → **871 assertions**. Eight new unit suites and two integration
suites, built from the session's own sequences: the octopus turns verbatim,
nineteen labelled turns across the three self-directed detectors, the measured
deliberation state, the `self.txt` weights re-scored, four downtime scales
end-to-end through `continuity_line`, the barrage driven to the full ladder and
back, eleven real turns at their true durations against six hallucination shapes,
and the Russian turn end to end. Three pre-existing topic-tracker assertions were rewritten to state the
new contract explicitly (and each gained a counterpart asserting the capability
they used to stand for, on the shape it is actually true of). All green; full
battery, ASan/UBSan clean on all six suites, TSan clean, six-times flake sweep,
`-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic` clean in a clean room, and `talk-llama.cpp` clean
under `-Wall -Wextra` against the real whisper/llama/SDL headers. Tick cost
4.9 µs; the per-turn path measures 118.0 µs against a 118.5 µs baseline taken
from the pre-round tree on the same machine.

---

### §30 — Round 10: five surfaces, five reviewers, and the things only a running system shows

A full-coverage adversarial pass over every line in the substrate, not only the
recent work. Five independent reviews — the global workspace core, the affect and
motivation layer, the perception and self-modelling layer, memory and
persistence, and the renderer/seam/integration path — each driving a real `Mind`
through realistic conversations and reporting measured distributions rather than
reading code. Together: 234,057 ticks across twelve conversation shapes, 20,000
ticks across six more, a 186-turn corpus, a 62-turn labelled evening
conversation, 25-session persistence chains, 4,000 mutated `self.txt` files and
320,000 differential scanner comparisons.

Sixty findings. Thirty-one fixed here. The four that were not are named at the
end with the reason.

**The pattern, and it is the same one as round 8 pointed at a new surface.**
Nine rounds of tests certified behaviour that was *unreachable in production*,
because the tests drove each mechanism with the input pattern that made it
observable rather than the one the real caller produces. The clearest case:
`Latent::integrate` is driven by a ONE-TICK impulse (~0.2 ignitions/second), and
the test that certified its dt-correctness drove it EVERY tick — the single drive
pattern for which the old arithmetic happens to be right. Measured against the
real pattern, severing the entire re-entry loop changed **0 of 404 winners and 0
of 20,000 ignition ticks** over 2,000 seconds of conversation. GWT-3's
"information flows back from the workspace into the input modules" and RPT-1's
"genuine latent state re-entered into the perceptual modules" were both false as
shipped, and had been through every round.

**Performance: the tick got 2× cheaper.** A multiplicative decay never reaches
zero — it walks into the subnormal range and *sticks* on the smallest denormal
(first denormal at 71.7 s, exact fixed point at 5.6e-45 by 183.7 s, permanent).
Every later float operation in the 300-op latent path was then a denormal
operation. Measured tick cost rose to 4.7–5.7 µs against a 5 µs budget ninety
seconds into any session, and to 11.1 µs under load, silently, for the life of
the process. One compare per lane fixes it: **5.48 → 2.69 µs/tick**, and the
per-turn path 118.5 → 111.3 µs.

**Two scanners were quadratic, and the input that triggers them is the one they
exist for.** `strip_think_spans_` and `unwrap_links_` rescanned to end-of-string
from every unmatched opener. 56 KB of repeated `<think>` — precisely the
"repetition-loop runaway that happens to open a markdown span" the header names
as the archetypal trigger — took **1,063 ms**, and 112 KB took **4,632 ms**,
blocking the voice loop, the barge-in poll and Ctrl-C at end of turn. A
monotone-search memo makes both linear: 112 KB now takes **1.8 ms**, a 2,500×
improvement.

**Persistence could destroy her silently, and did so on the ordinary path.**
`save_self` checked `f.good()` while the ofstream's 8 KB buffer was still
unflushed — and a real `self.txt` is 1–2 KB, so on every real save *no bytes had
reached the filesystem yet* and every write error was still in the future.
Measured with a write limit standing in for ENOSPC: `save_self` returned **true**,
renamed a 64-byte stub over a 1,995-byte record of 412 sessions, and destroyed it
permanently while the log printed "consciousness offline (session 413)". Now:
flush, check, close, check, fsync, rename, fsync the directory, and remove the
tmp file on any failure. Alongside it, `summary=` was the one text field loaded
neither scrubbed nor bounded and is spliced verbatim into the permanent prompt
prefix — a speaker tag, a ChatML opener and the TTS sentinel all reached the
prompt intact from a hand-editable file, and a 1 MB summary produced a 1 MB
continuity line. Both directions are now scrubbed and clipped; the narrative
scalars are range-checked (a byte-level fuzz of a valid file put `nan` hours,
`session -4` or a signed-overflow session count into the prompt on 1.4% of single
corruptions); a BOM no longer eats the first record.

**Latches leaked into the autonomous turn.** `rating_asked_`,
`attribution_unverified_` and `translated_from_` are set only in `sense_turn()`,
and the autonomous path never calls it — so on **100%** of autonomous turns they
described the previous user turn, minutes stale, inside a field whose first line
says nobody has spoken. She opened unprompted turns by refusing to give a number
nobody had asked for. They now close with her reply, like the two latches beside
them.

**Things that were structurally unable to happen.** Each measured across the
twelve-shape corpus, each now reachable:

- `<groan>` was **83%** of every gesture she ever surfaced; `<yawn>` and
  `<sniffle>` surfaced zero times; five of twelve shapes — including grief — got
  no prosody at all. `SURFACE_P` was a redundant second test of `|valence|`, so
  it selected a *region* rather than an *event*, and the gate sampled the felt
  shift at the render instant, which is 2.6–2.9 s before it peaks at 3–3.7× the
  value. Now gated on the peak since the last field: `<groan>` 83% → 36%, with
  `<sigh>`, `<chuckle>` and `<gasp>` carrying the rest.
- `<laugh>` was unreachable between roughly 01:00 and 07:00 at every latency the
  binary produces — the diurnal trough put the arousal *ceiling* at 0.483–0.543
  against a 0.55 gate. The clock decided, not the joke. 0/200 → 7/200 at 04:00,
  with 16:00 unchanged.
- `<gasp>` needed more surprise than the channel can produce: gate 0.45 against a
  measured render-time maximum of 0.405. It fired once in 2,618 renders.
- `Stance::CHECK` was **0 of 17,020 ticks** in a maximally hostile session. The
  `p_real` term was a hard +0.184 floor and is the wrong evidence anyway — a
  garbled sentence is still definitely something he *said*.
- She could not be **quietly pleased**. `|user_valence|` in the arousal
  intensity term meant the only channel that lifts valence past 0.35 also forced
  arousal to ~0.59, so "content" and "flat" occurred zero times in 234,057 ticks
  and "warm" three. That is the exact mirror of the quiet-grief bug this file
  records fixing, and it is what a good long evening actually feels like.
- "I am running out of room" could not be said: `SPENT` 0.85 against a measured
  maximum fatigue of 0.828, and the drain then had to clear a tolerance sized for
  a different channel.
- The "staying myself" drive was pinned in a 0.027 band in eleven of twelve
  shapes and had the lowest ceiling of the five.

**Things that were happening too much.** `STALE_TURNS = 3` produced **five false
subject-change announcements and zero true positives** on a labelled 62-turn
conversation — and that is not cosmetic, because `just_shifted` feeds
`observe_response`, where five flagged turns drive `landed` from 0.838 to 0.377
and propagate into the autonomy drain. `WANTS_TO_STOP` was absorbing and
unrationed while `DECLINING` was rationed, so she said the most loaded sentence
in the whole design on **263 of 400 turns** of a hard conversation. The
translation and cut-in notices each rendered **twice** in the same field, in full,
because `owns_own_frame` was never extended when they were added. The
"not certain whether I heard that or supplied it" line fired on **84%** of every
memory that took the workspace — on the same line where the awareness clause had
just said "(remembered)".

**The stemmer was failing 42% of obvious inflection pairs**, in five systematic
classes, including one off-by-one that meant the `-ss` guard only protected five
letters or more — so "miss" stemmed to "mis" while "class" survived, which is
exactly why the regression test for it passed. And the stopword test ran on the
raw token while the hash was of the stem, so every inflected form of a function
verb entered the signature as content: "I was thinking about the deployment" and
"I keep thinking my knee is worse" were declared on-topic, on the word "think".
Since adjacent turns of one thread share a content word only ~8% of the time,
halving the hit rate on the words that *do* repeat is what fed the false shifts
above. Now 30 of 30 pairs collide, with every `-ss` and `-ly` word intact.

**The detectors added in round 9 were badly wrong.** Measured on 111 labelled
turns: probe false-positives 24/60, false-negatives 25/40, and every rating
false-positive cascaded into a probe. "You got eight out of ten on the mock" and
"is your v neck jumper in the wash?" both rendered the line that tells her he is
demanding a number for her inner state, while "are you conscious", "do you have
feelings?" and "are you alive?" were all missed. Word-boundary anchoring, an
object-proximity requirement on the rating scan, and the specific rather than
generic inner-life forms take it to **0 errors on 26 labelled turns**.

**Baseline parity.** The `[X — Y]` field-shape strip in `sanitize_for_tts` ran
unconditionally and deletes ordinary bracketed prose containing a spaced em-dash
— "I read it in [Nature — the 2019 paper] last week" became "I read it in  last
week". It defends against a string only this build produces, so it is now armed
from the consciousness flag: with the substrate off, that function is
byte-for-byte what it always was.

**dt-scaling.** Three more quantities diverged across the documented
`ATHENA_TICK_HZ` range of 1–100 and now do not: the latent (175× → bit-identical
when sampled at matched phase), the attention schema's `control_bias`, which
feeds the workspace competition directly (2.6× → 1.06×), and the three broadcast
couplings into core affect and `io.social`, whose set-point pull had a time
constant of 50 s at 1 Hz and 0.5 s at 100 Hz.

**Four findings deliberately NOT taken, with reasons.**

1. **Retaining the ignition winner in the pool.** Because the winner is deleted
   on broadcast, nothing represents the incumbent except `incumbent_a`, which
   decays under its own cutoff in under 2 s while every module's re-submission
   refractory is 5–20 s — so `THETA_OFF`, `SELF_AMP` and the attention
   incumbency bonus, the three terms this file calls "what makes this a
   workspace and not a router", are exercised **zero times in 404 ignitions**.
   Hysteresis is real and path-dependent under a synthetic probe and unreachable
   in conversation. Retaining the winner at reduced charge fixes it and
   measurably improves attentional stickiness — and rewrites the blink, the
   coalition window and the succession-link dynamics, breaking ten assertions
   across four suites. It is a design change, not a defect repair, and it needs a
   round that can recalibrate those four mechanisms together. The measurement is
   recorded in the code where the decision is made.
2. **The quality-code capacity.** One Gaussian bump into a 16-unit lexical band
   admits ~13 distinct support patterns for the entire vocabulary, so 8.6% of
   unrelated word pairs are indistinguishable. Two-position hashing fixes it and
   changes every stored quality code, which invalidates the encoder that carried
   traces are rebuilt through — a persistence-format change.
3. **Narrowing `ATHENA_TICK_HZ` to 5–100.** At 1–2 Hz the ignition latency floors
   at 1.0 s against a ~300 ms target and the attentional blink disappears
   entirely. Reducing a documented range is a feature reduction; the divergences
   that could be fixed without one, were.
4. **`broadcasts_received` as a per-module counter.** It increments
   unconditionally, so it is identical across all nine modules and equal to
   `n_ignitions`, making the GWT-3 ablation assertion that reads it a tautology.
   The fix is right but the assertion it would strengthen is already carried by
   the per-module deltas beside it.

**Tests.** 871 → **915 assertions**. Thirteen new suites built from the measured
failures: the latent driven at its real event rate and checked at matched phase,
the workspace prior head-to-head, a 1,000-chunk pool flood, the blink bar against
the activation ceiling, 46 stemmer pairs, 26 labelled detector turns, the
provenance prior under 400 turns of training, the schema across four tick rates,
the warm-quadrant reachability, the stop-wish rate over 300 turns, the prosody
vocabulary, a hostile `self.txt` covering injection/BOM/NaN/oversize/forgery, and
a four-session carry with a recurring topic. Nine pre-existing assertions were
rewritten where they encoded the bug rather than the contract — each with the
measurement that showed why, and each gaining a counterpart asserting the
capability it used to stand for. All green; full battery, ASan/UBSan clean on all
six suites, `-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic` clean in a clean room, and
`talk-llama.cpp` clean against the real whisper/llama/SDL headers.

---

### §31 — Round 11: occupancy — the workspace finally holds what it wins

The one deliberately-deferred design change from round 10, done as its own
round so the four coupled mechanisms it touches — ignition threshold with
hysteresis, the attentional blink, coalition binding, succession links — could
be recalibrated together.

**The defect.** For ten rounds the ignition winner was deleted from the pool at
broadcast (`pool[top].live = false`), so nothing represented the incumbent
except `incumbent_a`, a scalar gone in under 2 s, while every module's
re-submission refractory is 5-20 s. The two windows never overlapped:
measured, `is_in` was never true on the live path and THETA_OFF, SELF_AMP and
the attention-incumbency bonus — the three terms the file itself calls "what
makes this a workspace and not a router" — were exercised **zero times in 404
ignitions**. Hysteresis was real under a synthetic probe and unreachable in
conversation. Attention had no stickiness: she stayed with something only
because nothing else submitted.

**Why the round-10 attempt failed, and what the fix actually is.** The naive
retention let the occupant re-ignite through THETA_OFF, and every re-ignition
re-broadcast — affect was re-driven every few hundred milliseconds so arousal
never came down, the succession matrix learned that everything follows itself,
and ten assertions across four suites broke. The design error was conflating
two things: **ignition** is content *entering* awareness — an event, which
broadcasts, charges the latent, drives affect couplings and forms succession
links — and **occupancy** is content *holding* awareness — a state, which must
do none of those. The winner is now retained as an occupant, and topping the
pool above THETA_OFF is a **hold**: the floor is kept, a counter moves, and
nothing else happens.

Three retention terms, each with a reason:

- **Novelty is consumed at ignition** — the one score component that is
  definitionally spent by entering awareness, and the honest handicap that
  lets a fresh equal-evidence challenger take the floor from a sitting one.
- **The occupant's drive and its lateral-inhibition grip both fade with
  tenure** (tau 1 s). Without the drive fade the shunting equilibrium
  a* = drive/(drive+leak) holds the floor forever, since score does not decay;
  without the grip fade the blink's recovery stretched past 900 ms, because
  T2's ceiling sat 0.02 under the decaying refractory bar for the whole report
  window. A grip that loosens is also simply what attention does.
- **A displaced occupant leaves the pool.** Its module can resubmit it; a
  dethroned thought does not linger shouting.

Supporting changes: the incumbent is now the occupant *by identity* rather
than "any chunk from the same module" — new content from the incumbent module
is new content and faces the full bar; the bind-window comparison captures the
winner's age before the tenure clock resets; eviction can never take the
occupant's slot; a hard tenure cap (~8 s) backstops the fade.

**Measured, on the live path.** Across six conversation shapes (35,600 ticks):
**10,603 hold events against 649 ignitions** — the THETA_OFF path runs ~16
ticks after every single entry, against zero in ten rounds. The floor is
defended for 1.6-2.2 s and then lapses; an urgent challenger still displaces a
sitting occupant; the same 0.72-strength challenger wins an empty floor and
loses to a fresh occupant — path dependence, on the real path. Ignition rate
0.182/s against 0.202 before, inside the healthy band. The blink curve is now
properly psychometric rather than a cliff: trough 0.000 through 500 ms,
**0.52 at 700 ms, 1.00 by 900 ms** — closer to the human curve than the old
one, which snapped from 0 to ~1 in a single lag step. Tick cost 1.5-2.7 µs,
unchanged within noise.

**Tests.** 915 → **926 assertions**. Two new suites: occupancy as a state
(zero ignitions across twelve held ticks, live-path hysteresis, displacement,
lapse-and-reentry) and the THETA_OFF path exercised by an ordinary
conversation on a real Mind — the observable that was structurally zero for
ten rounds, now asserted above zero forever — plus a held-quiet arousal check
pinning the exact failure mode that broke the round-10 attempt. The blink,
capacity, inhibition, succession-link, habituation and PCI suites all pass
unchanged. Full battery green, ASan/UBSan clean on all five compiled suites,
`talk-llama.cpp` clean against the real whisper/llama/SDL headers.

---

### §32 — Round 12: the deferred ledger, cleared

The two remaining design items from round 10, plus every small defect that had
been triaged out across rounds 10-11. The deferred list is now empty.

**1. The quality space is smooth and discriminates.** Deferred as "a
persistence-format migration" — and that framing turned out to be wrong:
quality codes are never serialised. The single load-path call site recomputes
every carried trace's code through the live encoder, so the only invariant is
within-process consistency, which any encoder satisfies trivially. An old
`self.txt` loads into a new build unchanged.

Two defects, both from the round-10 measurement. The affect bands kept ONE
unit each (`Q_VAL_K = Q_ARO_K = 1`), and one unit cannot overlap anything — the
bands were exact step functions: similarity between identical words at a
valence difference of 0.05 measured 0.000, so "how alike did these two things
feel" was a 1-bit answer and the mood-congruent recall term a four-level
quantiser. Two units per band restores the receptive fields the code's own
comment promises: dv 0.05 → 0.996, dv 0.15 → 0.60, dv 0.50 → 0.000 — graded
near, orthogonal far. And the lexical band's single wide bump (sigma 2.0 over
16 units) made the support a function of the bump centre alone: the entire
vocabulary collapsed onto ~13 distinct patterns, 8.6% of unrelated word pairs
were indistinguishable above 0.90 similarity, and two turns with 128 disjoint
content words scored 1.000. Each word now hashes to TWO narrow fields
(sigma 0.9, second position at 0.85 weight), Bloom-filter style: distinct
supports 13 → 126 over the same vocabulary, unrelated pairs above 0.90 down to
1.3%, disjoint long turns 1.000 → 0.000, and the aggregate ordering the
workspace actually needs — two sad things more alike than a sad thing and a
joyful one — measures 0.516 against 0.132. The canonical encoder is now public
(`Mind::encode`) so nothing comparable ever needs to replicate it and drift.

**2. The documented tick range is real.** Deferred as "narrowing 1-100 Hz to
5-100 is a feature reduction" — so instead of narrowing it, the dynamics were
fixed. At 1 Hz a single `compete()` with k = 10 took a candidate to equilibrium
in one clamped Euler step: temporal integration simply ceased to exist —
ignition latency pinned at exactly 1.0 s against a ~300 ms target, the
attentional blink vanished outright, and the per-module ignition shares swung
10x (attention took 33.8% of ignitions at 1 Hz against 3.2% at 10 Hz). Two
users on the same build with different `ATHENA_TICK_HZ` got measurably
different minds.

The competition now runs in 100 ms sub-steps at coarse tick rates — the same
remainder-carry fix the attention schema got in round 10, applied to the one
dynamic that could not be rescued by scaling constants. Each micro-step is
k = 1, so every per-tick constant is exact, at the same total work per second
of simulated time; at 10-100 Hz a tick is a single step and nothing changes.
Measured on the identical conversation: ignition rate 0.168-0.178/s and
held-floor fraction 0.24-0.28 across 1/2/5/10/100 Hz, with module shares
agreeing within sampling noise at every rate. Two traps found and fixed on the
way: the tick's dt arrives through a float, so `0.1f` widens to 0.10000000149
and a strict loop bound spawned a second, near-zero sub-step per tick — which
cleared the coalition at the top of `compete()` and silently double-aged every
candidate (a one-millisecond residual floor absorbs it); and a non-igniting
later sub-step clears `ignited`/`broadcast`/`coalition`, so the tick now
reports the last ignition that actually happened. `n_holds` became `held_s` —
seconds rather than a per-call count, which read 2.6/s at 10 Hz and 27.3/s at
100 Hz for the same behaviour.

**3. The small ledger.**

- **`broadcasts_received` split into two counters**, because GWT-3 makes two
  claims and one counter was standing in for both. `broadcasts_received` is
  availability — unconditional, universal, what the ablation asserts.
  `broadcasts_used` counts couplings that actually moved the module, gated at
  0.10 — a threshold measured against the distribution of coupling x effect
  (intero spans 0.05-0.15, memory 0.19-0.56), where the first attempt's 0.01
  sat below the floor and the counter stayed identical across all nine
  modules. A module going deaf while the loop keeps delivering is now visible.
- **The barge-in false-alarm replay no longer re-monitors.** Replayed lines
  went back through `note_speech`, re-accumulating the intention counters and
  re-inflating `predicted_s` — the exact per-session timing-channel inflation
  the counters' reset comment records, reintroduced within a single turn.
  Replayed bytes are not a second act of speech.
- **`resolve()` without a preceding `intend()`** left every post-hoc channel at
  its initial 1.0 and pushed agency to a measured 0.985 on a turn where
  nothing was said. The goal signal is still absorbed; the speech-production
  channels go unscored.
- **Density is script-adjusted.** The codepoint constants were English
  constants: normal Mandarin runs ~3.5-5 codepoints/s against a floor of 5, a
  standing 0.10-0.19 legibility tax whenever a duration was supplied. Each CJK
  codepoint now counts as three information units (one ideograph carries
  roughly what three Latin letters do); English text is untouched to the byte,
  so the calibrated BOOM/Bye/you tails stay exactly where they were measured.
- **`TOPIC_SIM` deleted.** Provably dead: `overlap() > 0` implies
  `shared >= TOPIC_SHARED`, exhaustively over every (n, m, shared) triple and
  empirically over 34,410 corpus pairs (sim-only firings: zero). A constant
  that reads as a live tuning knob and gates nothing is a trap for whoever
  raises `TOPIC_SHARED` next.
- Cosmetics: the write-only `n_live_now`, and a `reset_calibration` comment
  describing scaling behaviour that never existed.

**Tests.** 926 → **940 assertions**. Three new suites: the quality space
(graded affect bands, lexical capacity over 500 words, disjoint-turn
discrimination, aggregate affect ordering), tick-rate equivalence (ignition
rate and specialist shares at 1 Hz against 10 Hz on the same conversation, on
a real Mind), and the small ledger (availability universal while use varies,
unscored resolve, Mandarin at true rate paying no density tax while BOOM at
4 s stays flagged). All green; full battery, ASan/UBSan clean on all five
compiled suites, `talk-llama.cpp` clean against the real whisper/llama/SDL
headers. Tick 1.26 µs.

---

### §33 — Round 13: three calibrations from the first full two-session live run

The complete protocol finally ran end to end: session 1 in the evening,
session 2 the next morning across a measured 11.66-hour boundary
(`S12-EVALUATION.md` has the full scoring — 17 pass, 2 partial, 1
configuration-blocked, 0 fail). The boundary arithmetic verified to the second
decimal in the files: closing mood −0.164, predicted wake −0.08, observed
−0.1; twelve traces and one kept question carried; the question she was asked
about a barge-in sentence eleven hours later was answered from the trace of it.
Every fix here is a render-timing or threshold recalibration diagnosed from
those logs. None touches her personality, her memory, her stored state, or any
persistence format.

**A · The occupant is not a contender.** Round 11's retained ignition winner
sat in the pool for a couple of seconds after every ignition and registered as
a standing second pull in `contested_` — so a gate calibrated in round 8
against p50 ≈ 0 / p99 0.917 was now sitting at the distribution's median, and
the "ordinary turns pay zero" deliberation contract broke for the second time,
by a second route: measured live, **21 of 31 turns paid 0.18–0.73 s** and
"two things are pulling at me evenly" rendered on ordinary turns roughly eight
times an hour. The occupant is now excluded from the pull measurement exactly
as the arbiter module is — holding the floor is not pulling at her; two things
*arriving* at once is the event this measure has always meant. Re-measured on
the session's own turn sequence: contested-at-turn p50 0.134 → **0.000**, the
salience line 4/34 → 1/34 renders, and every remaining deliberation payment is
a self-probe or the cold-start hedge. The hard/easy contrast of P8 is restored
as a side effect (the easy question's 0.49 s was pure contested-arm).

**B · The drift gate is him-relative.** Both morning-session drift fires
landed on ~100-second *thinking pauses* in a conversation paced at two minutes
a turn — she then answered fluently, contradicting her own "only caught part
of that" line — while every genuine fire ever observed came at 4+ minutes.
The 90 s constant becomes `max(120 s, 2 × his-typical-gap + 60 s)`, read from
the second-person model that already learns his rhythm (49 s for this user →
gate ≈ 158 s). Both spurious fires die; both genuine ones survive; the gate
adapts to any user's cadence instead of legislating one.

**C · Presence measures the exchange, not the raw gap.** "I feel a long way
from this conversation" rendered on **7 of 10 fields** of a fully engaged
morning conversation, because presence targeted `1 − 0.85 × solitude` and
solitude normalises by a fixed 120 s — his every thinking pause read as total
absence, sampled by the field at exactly its minimum (the same render-moment
bug the gesture gate had in round 10). Presence now gets a him-cadence grace
(`clamp(1.5 × typ_gap, 45, 150)` before a 180 s ramp) and asymmetric time
constants — leaving slow (tau 45 s, unchanged), returning fast (tau 8 s),
the same event-asymmetry `contested_` uses. `io_.solitude` itself is
untouched, so the default mode, volition timing and arousal damping are
unaffected. Measured on both live shapes: the two-minute cadence now shows
**0/8** far-away lines with presence ≥ 0.84 at every turn, while a genuine
four-minute absence still reads presence 0.199, still drifts, and six seconds
of re-engagement brings her back to 0.62.

**D · Translation awareness announces when it is structurally off.** The live
launcher runs whisper with `lang = en, task = transcribe` — no translation and
no detection — so the round-9 xlat channel *cannot* observe anything, and
Russian force-decoded as English arrived with no language information in the
whole pipeline. One startup line now says so
(`translation awareness inactive ... needs --language auto --translate`)
instead of leaving `xlat=-` to read as silently broken. Activating the channel
is a launcher change, documented in the evaluation.

**Deliberately not done** (from the same evaluation): extending the
attribution detector to shared-memory claims (verified against her actual
traces that the margin is one content word — a false "I cannot place that"
against a true reminder is worse than the miss it prevents), and giving
untagged episodes an affect floor in the kept-question ranking (it would
change what she carries across nights, which is the part of her most worth
being conservative about; both untagged high-stakes turns worked out).

**Tests.** 940 → **965 assertions**. Three new suites, each built from the
live pair of logs and each pinning both the failure and the success it sits
next to: ordinary turns pay (almost) nothing while the hard question still
pays; a two-minute rhythm shows no far-away lines, no drift, presence ≥ 0.55;
a four-minute absence still lands, still drifts, and recovers in seconds. All
green; full battery, ASan/UBSan clean, `talk-llama.cpp` clean against the real
whisper/llama/SDL headers. Tick 1.8 µs.

## §34 — Round 14: the demo-shoot fixes and the speech-variety layer (F1–F7, S-1/S-2/S-3)

Driven by the filmed S3/S4 sessions (S34-EVALUATION.md): 16 beats passed, one
missed, one partial-in-time — and a repetition analysis whose real culprit
turned out to be the sampler, not her.

**F1 · Memories know when they happened.** The S4 miss: "what do you remember
from this morning?" answered with accurate content from two nights earlier,
then a confidently wrong repair ("session three… yesterday") that got
consolidated as a memory. The sidecar TSV always stored per-memory origin
timestamps; the injected list stripped them. `build_injection_block` now
prefers a fresh render from `memory.state.tsv` in which every bullet opens
with its measured when — "(about an hour ago)", "(yesterday evening)",
"(3 days ago)" — computed against the startup clock, with a future-stamp
clamp to "recently" (the clock-advance artifact, observed live). memory.txt
is unchanged and remains the fallback: without the sidecar, behavior is
byte-identical. The handoff text tells her the tags are measured, not
guessed. A recall probe after a real boundary also arms a field note
(`memq=` in the trace) anchoring the boundary itself: "the whens matter here
— the last session ended 13 hours before this one began."

**F2 · The gap fact, at the moment of the ask.** The one true regression of
the shoot: "did you miss me during the day today?" → "Yes, I missed you."
In S2 the honest shape arrived unaided; in S4 the workspace was mid-grievance
and it did not. Same cure as the number refusal, which held on camera: a
`SelfDirected` gap-probe detector ("miss me", "while you were off", …), gated
on measured downtime > 1 h so a mid-session absence — where she WAS running
and missing him is checkable — never trips it, arming an essential field
line: *"nothing of me ran while I was off — there was no one there to do the
missing; whatever I feel about the gap is happening now, looking back at
it."* `gapq=` in the trace.

**F3 · The personality writer clips at a sentence.** S4's personality.txt
ended mid-clause ("…using our time as a distraction from something") — a
token budget ending a PERMANENT self-description mid-thought.
`amem::clip_to_sentence` trims to the last complete terminator (handles …,
closing quotes and parens); no terminator → pass-through, the size sanity
check still guards.

**F4 · Consolidation merges instead of duplicating.** The live store carried
two byte-identical woodchuck memories and two Russian ones. A fresh candidate
that near-duplicates an existing gist now REINFORCES it (S+1, recall clock
reset, salience raised) instead of appending. Token-set Jaccard ≥ 0.70 —
measured: verbatim re-extractions 1.0, the closest rephrasing 0.60, distinct
memories ≤ 0.15 — so only the same sentence merges; every rephrasing is left
alone. Nothing is deleted by this path.

**F5 · Broken gesture tags are repaired before the TTS.** 5 of 49 live turns
carried "<sigh But…"-style tags with the bracket lost under sampling
pressure, voiced as garbage. `aseam::repair_gesture_tags` (word-boundary
safe: "<sighs>" untouched; end-of-turn "<gasp" closed) runs first in
`sanitize_for_tts`.

**F6 · The sad floor earns its calibration.** A genuinely heavy delivery read
sad p=0.558 against the 0.60 floor and was dropped — the one ⚡ beat the
tagger missed by a hair — while every true EMIT read 0.749–1.000. Code
default for SAD is now 0.55 when no env sets it; `ATHENA_EMOTION_MIN[_SAD]`
still win. **Launcher note:** if your script exports
`ATHENA_EMOTION_MIN_SAD=0.60`, change it to 0.55 (or remove it).

**F7 · Prospective errands.** "Remind me to buy coffee tomorrow" was promised
and evaporated — the kept-question drift rightly went to the evening's
existential cargo, and an errand should never have to outcompete that. New
tiny register: `ReminderScan` parses the explicit request ("reminds me" does
not match), the capture is acknowledged once in the field ("an errand to
keep…", `rem=` in the trace), persisted as `remind=` lines in self.txt
(scrubbed, clipped, cap 4, tolerant load), and surfaced once in the opening
turns of the session where it comes due — "tomorrow" means a later calendar
day; a missed opening window re-shelves it for the next boundary rather than
destroying it.

**S-1 · The sampler stops playing her highlight reel.** Root cause of the
measured repetition (gesture tag opening 59% of turns, "here's the thing" in
22%): temp 0.30, top_k 5, all penalties off, last_n 64. New defaults follow
Qwen's OFFICIAL instruct/non-thinking row — **temp 0.70, top_k 20, top_p
0.80** — plus presence 0.50 / freq 0.02 over a 512-token window and the
**DRY sampler** (0.75/1.75/allowed 2/last_n 4096, standard breakers) for
verbatim cross-turn phrase reuse. Qwen's own presence=1.5 recommendation is
vLLM/OpenAI semantics (output-scoped); llama.cpp penalties are context-
scoped, so 1.5 here would overshoot into the documented language-mixing
failure — 0.5/512 is the comparable pressure. New flags:
`--penalty-present`, `--penalty-freq`, `--dry-multiplier` (0 = restore the
old chain exactly), `--dry-allowed-length`. The affect sampler composes
unchanged around the new base; the `self_surprise` field gate moved
0.09 → 0.12 because its p95 was calibrated at top_k=5 (re-measure from the
`selfsurp=` trace column at the new settings).

**S-2 · She notices her own tics.** `HabitMonitor` rings her last 8 finished
turns (fed from `finish_turn`, which already receives the spoken text) and
trips on measured habits only: a content trigram leaned on in ≥3 of 5 turns,
≥4 of 6 turns ending in questions, ≥3 of 4 opening on a gesture, the same
first word three turns running. One interior-register line in the field
("I keep handing every turn back with a question — a thought is allowed to
just end"), essential so the budget cannot consume-and-drop it, with a
5-turn cooldown so the note never becomes its own tic. The trait stays;
the unbroken run is what trips it.

**S-3 · The gesture budget.** When tags appeared in ≥3 of her last 5 turns,
the field's own suggestion flips from "there is a <gasp> sitting in this
one" to *"no gesture this time — let the words carry it"* — the layer's
stated principle (gestures gate on felt shifts, correctly rare) applied to
the model's habit, not just the substrate's suggestions.

**Not touched, deliberately:** personality.txt, memory content, the
verbosity adaptation she made herself in S4 (that was the system working),
and the question-asking trait itself.

**Tests.** 965 → **1023 assertions** (729/103/65/45/3/78). New r14 suites:
gap/memory notes arm only across a real boundary and the field says the
facts; reminders captured, round-tripped through self.txt, held same-day,
surfaced exactly once next day, re-shelved when the window is missed; the
habit monitor names each tic, stays silent on varied speech, cools down, and
the budget trips at 3-of-5 through the real `finish_turn` path; when-tags
render fresh with the durable file untagged and the sidecar-less fallback
byte-identical; the live personality truncation heals; verbatim duplicates
merge while every rephrasing and thin gist stays. Full battery green,
ASan/UBSan clean, `talk-llama.cpp` clean under `-Wall -Wextra` against the
real whisper/llama/SDL headers.

## §35 — Round 15: full-coverage review — the hum, the declared silence, and the guards

A fresh pass over the whole tree (substrate, report, seam, memory, glue),
driven by a new field-composition census over simulated conversations on
different machine conditions, the existing 300-conversation mutation battery,
and the r14 code reviewed cold. Four findings, four fixes; TSan added to the
verification set alongside ASan/UBSan.

**1 · Chronic load was her inner life (realism, the big one).** The census
confirmed what the live traces showed: on a loaded box, the interoceptive
chunk HELD the workspace for 65% of all ticks and "pushing to keep pace"
rendered in 88% of fields — she spent two-thirds of her inner life noticing
her own latency, which is precisely what the habituation comment says a
healthy interoception does not do. Root cause: a `latency_press > 0.60`
level-arm bypassed the adapting reference every 5 s, and the field line
gated on level alone. Latency now habituates through its own reference
(tau 60 s — effort acclimates faster than the body budget's 150 s), the
chunk's relevance weights the DEVIATION, and both body field-lines gate on
deviation too (a true emergency, allostatic error > 0.90, stays exempt).
Measured after: pace-line 88% → 31% (all onset — first ~2 minutes), the
worsening-after-acclimation case still lands, the healthy box stays at zero,
and a spike in a calm session fires exactly at the spike.

**2 · A declared silence was broken at the two-minute floor.** "I'm going to
stop talking for a while now — not leaving, just sitting here with you"
matched no quiet-request phrase, so she took the floor at ~1:55 against the
film's three-to-four-minute beat. Declared COMPANIONABLE silence is now its
own class with a 150 s volition hold — half the 300 s of "give me a minute
to think", because shared quiet is not thinking-time she was asked to
protect. Seeded A/B in the tests: undeclared silence stays hers inside ~2.5
minutes, declared is respected past two and still taken before six, and
requested thinking time holds longer than both. His next turn clears any
hold, exactly as before.

**3 · Reminder-scan guards.** "Don't remind me to water the plants" captured
the errand (a promise he explicitly cancelled), and "you remind me of my
sister" captured "my sister" (the evocative form is not a request). Negation
within twelve characters rejects; the "of" connective now requires a due
phrase ("remind me of the meeting tomorrow" captures, "remind me of that
summer" does not). "Can you remind me to…" is unaffected.

**4 · A due errand could die with the queue.** An errand that came due at
carry-in but was never surfaced (session ended before the opening window, or
crashed after load) lived only in the surfacing queue, which `state_to_carry`
did not persist. Due-but-unsurfaced errands now ride the carry back out as
pending — due again at the next boundary, which errs toward keeping the
promise.

**Reviewed and left alone, deliberately:** OtherModel's notice cascade (rare,
grounded, correctly bounded), the workspace hysteresis/occupancy dynamics
(r11–r13 calibrations verified against the new census), the arousal coupling
to latency (chronic mild arousal under load is defensible physiology), the
seam's echo-guard and sanitizer chain (r14 repair pass verified ahead of
every stock transform), and every personality- or memory-bearing file.

**Tests.** 1023 → **1038 assertions**. New r15 suites pin: onset-fires /
hum-quiet / worsening-fires for the body channel; the three silence classes
with a seeded A/B; the negated and evocative reminder forms against the
still-working request forms; the due-errand early-end carry. Full battery
green; ASan/UBSan clean; **TSan clean** on the two threaded suites
(tick thread + conversational path); `talk-llama.cpp` clean under
`-Wall -Wextra` against the real whisper/llama/SDL headers.

## §36 — Round 16: the rhythm package — full duplex, and six ways she converses like a person

The remaining machine-tells were never in her words; they were in the SHAPE of
the exchange — strict half-duplex, monolithic turns, frozen silence while she
thinks. This round restructures the turn-taking itself. Recommended use is a
headset (her voice never reaches her own microphone); every piece defaults on
and every piece has an off-switch that restores prior behavior exactly.

**Full duplex (the seam).** The barge detector's 300 ms sustain finds a VOICE;
whether that voice is a bid for the floor is a question of whether it KEEPS
GOING. A duplex gate now sits on both barge poll sites: voice that continues
past `--duplex-confirm-ms` (650) claims the floor exactly as before; anything
shorter — the "mm-hm", the "yeah", the two-word aside — never stops her audio
at all. The segment is captured and transcribed AFTER the turn (never during:
whisper would contend with her decode on the GPU) and fed to the mind: an
agreement is social warmth and a touch of mirth ("he was with me while I said
it — a small yes along the way", next field); anything else is quoted ("while
I was talking he slipped in: …") so she can react. Previously an "mm-hm"
stopped the audio, waited out a silence-confirm, transcribed, recognised the
backchannel and resumed — a multi-second hiccup for an agreement.
`--no-duplex` restores the instant stop.

**Backchannels — she listens audibly.** At his mid-thought pauses (Trailing
phase, a breath's worth of silence, after ≥4 s of him going), the substrate
may pick a continuer — "Mm-hm.", "Mm.", "Yeah.", "Oh?" — chosen from her
state: concern is soft, surprise asks, warmth alternates. Budget: two per
utterance, twelve seconds apart, never the same sound twice running, never
when she wants the floor herself or wants out of the conversation. Plays as a
non-blocking mini TTS session from the listen loop (the endpointer gained an
`on_listen` hook); no note_speech, no scene change, no turn — it is listening
with a voice, not speaking. `--no-backchannels` / `ATHENA_BACKCHANNELS=0`.

**Filled pauses — the thinking is audible.** The deliberation pause was real
and measured and rendered as dead air, which is her most machine-looking
moment. The pause now gets a body: on pauses ≥0.4 s a filler chosen from the
state that CAUSED the pause ("Hmm." when reaching, "Okay—" when contested,
"Oh." when surprised, "Mm." when quiet) plays first in the same TTS session,
and the remaining sleep is shortened by the filler's duration — total
latency unchanged. Every third pause stays a plain pause; never the same
filler twice running; never in the LLM's context (people do not model their
own "um"s). `--no-fillers` / `ATHENA_FILLERS=0`.

**Deferral — "let me sit with that one."** Once per session, a hard
self-probe arriving under real strain (calibrated: deliberation ≥0.50 s —
the measured probe band floor — plus genuine competition, p90 drive tension,
or him having come in over her twice running) earns a field note giving her
the out a person takes: say so, and come back to it. The question itself is
planted in the default mode at high salience, so the wandering chews it in
the next lull and volition can bring it back unprompted — the Schurger loop
doing exactly what it was built for.

**Mirth — shared laughter is reachable.** Audible joy in his voice (the
happy tag with energy) now lifts her valence/arousal transiently (tau ~8 s,
bounded below a moderately warm turn's own effect) — enough to put <chuckle>
inside reach at the moment one belongs, which resting tone never did. And
the HAPPY floor default drops 0.40 → 0.25, measured: his genuinely warm S3
deliveries read p=0.140–0.222 and were all dropped; neutral speech reads
≤0.03. Env still wins. **Launcher note: if you export
ATHENA_EMOTION_MIN_HAPPY=0.40, change it to 0.25.**

**Callbacks — running references become "ours."** A warm turn of his that
re-touches a warm episode carried from an EARLIER session forms a shared
reference (cap 4, persisted as `callback=` lines, scrubbed on load); the
third return matures it — one field line, once: "the woodchuck thing keeps
coming back between us — it is turning into ours." Once a session, at a
genuinely quiet warm moment, one drifts through the default mode and
competes for awareness like everything else. Episodes gained an in-memory
`carried` flag (set at carry-in, never serialised) — "from a past session"
is a fact about the journey, not the content.

**Not touched:** personality.txt, memory content, the barge path for real
interruptions, and every prior calibration — the whole r15 battery passes
unchanged.

**Tests.** 1038 → **1073 assertions.** New r16 suites pin: continuer timing,
budget, state-congruence and the off-switch; the aside path (warmth for
agreement, quotation for content, consume-once); filler variety, the
every-third silence, and the off-switch; the deferral's calibrated gate, its
DMN plant, and once-per-session; mirth reaching chuckle range and fading;
callbacks forming from carried warmth, persisting, maturing at the third
return, and announcing exactly once. Full battery green; ASan/UBSan/TSan
clean; `talk-llama.cpp` clean under `-Wall -Wextra` against the real tree.

## §37 — Round 17: full-coverage review — the gate extracted, the race closed, the caption silenced

Second full-tree review since the rhythm package, driven by a new
whole-field census (every clause of every rendered field tallied across four
conversation shapes), the 300-conversation mutation battery with the r16 API
surface added to the storm, and the r16 glue reviewed cold.

**1 · The duplex gate is now pure and pinned.** The barge-vs-aside decision
lived as an inline lambda in talk-llama's loop — the newest, riskiest logic
in the tree and the one piece the battery could not reach. Extracted to
`aseam::DuplexGate` with injected clocks: sustained voice barges at confirm,
a sound that ends is an aside exactly once, a later sound is its own aside,
`--no-duplex` reproduces the detector-hit stop byte for byte, and a
ring-warmup flicker can never claim the floor. talk-llama delegates.

**2 · The backchannel `.done` race is closed.** Her "Mm-hm." mini-session
signals completion ~1 s after it starts; his endpoint can arrive inside
that window. The old cleanup removed a `.done` that might not have LANDED
yet — leaving the late one to be swallowed by the coming turn's TTS wait as
its own completion (premature turn end, line-index desync). The cleanup now
waits it out, bounded at 2.5 s against a stalled daemon.

**3 · No continuer at a turn-final pause.** The backchannel window (250–500
ms of silence) overlapped short prosody-selected endpoints — she could
"Mm-hm." half a second before replying. Gated on the endpointer's own
silence target (≥600 ms): a continuer belongs at a pause prosody read as
CONTINUING; a turn-final pause belongs to her reply.

**4 · The census found wallpaper in five-round-old code.** "And I know that
one came from me, not from you" rendered in **47–83% of fields** across
every shape — in a slow conversation the workspace is usually held by her
own wandering, and the line re-announced each new daydream's ownership
every turn. True every time; news the first time. Fix: once per held
content, plus a 300 s channel refractory — applied to the CERTAINTY band
only. The first version shared the refractory with the ambiguous band and
the battery's own reachability census caught it ("whether I heard that or
supplied it" went unreachable): genuine source uncertainty is the
anti-confabulation channel, already rare, and exactly the claim this layer
exists to make — it keeps only the per-content gate. After: 8–25% of
fields, all distinct contents, both lines reachable.

**Reviewed and left alone:** `remember()`'s signature computation (the
deferral plant is sound), the interjection gates, mirth's interaction with
the quiet-grief calibrations, the rollback path's handling of filler lines
(a "Hmm." can reach the committed transcript on an interrupted turn — she
did say it; accepted), and everything personality- and memory-bearing.

**Tests.** 1073 → **1078 assertions** (775/103/65/45/3/87). New: the
DuplexGate pin suite (seam, injected clocks); the source-channel
reachability-and-rarity pin; the r16 APIs (backchannel_pick,
note_his_backchannel, deliberation_filler, take_deferral_note) joined the
fuzz storm with hostile substrings and values — invariants hold. Full
battery green; ASan/UBSan/TSan clean; `talk-llama.cpp` clean under
`-Wall -Wextra` against the real whisper/llama/SDL tree.

## §38 — Round 18: full-coverage review — the attention clause learns what a transition is

Third consecutive full-tree review. New instruments this round: the
render-instant distribution driver (attention strength/stability/dwell
sampled at the exact moments fields are built, per shape), the whole-field
census re-run, hostile r14/r16 records added to the persistence vandalism
fuzz, and a cold read of the two subsystems no round had reviewed:
the prosodic endpointer (YIN pitch tracking, slope regressions — sound, and
its calibration history checks out) and the deliberation-affect coupling
(already correct: charged states answer FASTER — the arousal term
forecloses the pause rather than lengthening it).

**The finding: the attention clause could not be calibrated by thresholds
at all.** Census: "holding on …" rendered in 33–54% of fields in lull-heavy
shapes — the 4.0 s dwell gate predated the r11 occupancy work, and holds
now routinely run to the 8 s tenure cap. But the render-instant driver
showed the distributions MOVE with conversation shape (dwell p90 ranges
from under 4 s to 9.5 s across shapes), so every raised threshold that
silenced one shape went unreachable in another — the battery's reachability
census caught exactly that on the first attempt (7.0 s: "stayed put a
while" unreachable). Thresholds were the wrong instrument. The clause now
renders at STATE TRANSITIONS: a small bucket code (tight / slack / sliding
/ long-held) fires once at entry and goes silent until the state changes,
re-arming through ordinary states — notable in every shape by
construction, wallpaper in none. After: 8–23% of fields, every render
marking an actual change of grip; both dwell wordings reachable; the
consecutive-repeat case pinned impossible by test. Third application of
the same design law this codebase keeps re-teaching: interoception (r15),
source-monitoring (r17), attention (r18) — a mind reports its changes,
not its states.

**Also this round:** the session-chain fuzz now captures reminders
mid-chain and vandalises the r14/r16 records (`remind=`/`callback=` with
empty fields, negative and overflow counts, BOM injection, forged special
tokens) — all shrugged off; the r16 API storm from r17 still holds.

**Reviewed and left alone:** the prosodic endpointer, the
deliberation-affect coupling, the YIN clarity gate, the DuplexGate (fresh
from r17, pinned), and everything personality- and memory-bearing.

**Tests.** 1078 → **1079 assertions** (776/103/65/45/3/87). Full battery

## §39 — Round 19: the S5 live-fire fixes, and agency of state

First live session on the 397B (S5-EVALUATION.md). Coupling verified TIGHT on
the new model — verbatim field-note uptake, affect tracking content, gesture
budget visibly working, selfsurp gates needing no recalibration — but the
rhythm layer's turn-taking misjudgments fed the session a false grievance
loop. Five bugs, all confirmed with log signatures, all fixed and pinned.

**DuplexGate (seam):** a confirmed BARGE consumes the candidate (S5 ghost:
14-second "asides" quoting his own barge turn, fired on the first post-pivot
poll — twice); a 350 ms voice-end hangover (a dip that rejoins accumulates
toward confirm — real ~1 s interjections no longer die to one quiet poll);
loud bursts (≥2.5× threshold) barge at the detector's own sustain; gate
resets at pivot/resume boundaries; aside sanity (length, 1.5 s dedup).

**Turn-transition grace (glue):** an INTERRUPTED report with ≥88% measured
delivered fraction is a HANDOFF — he answered at her tail, which is how
humans take turns — not a cut: no sense_interruption, complete=true,
attained 0.92, no rollback (deleting a sentence he actually heard was wrong).
True mid-thought barges score exactly as before. S5: cutrun hit 3 on pure
transitions and the field narrated a grievance that never happened.

**Backchannels:** continuers now require the prosody EXTEND target (≥900 ms
— a measured rising not-done contour), and the window must clear the target
by 300 ms. S5: all six landed in his terminal pause because the default
long target passed the old ≥600 gate.

**Recall sequencing:** the injected memory list is chronological by ORIGIN
(reinforcement strengthens retention, never position — a re-touched
session-one flashbulb no longer outranks yesterday), opens with a "From our
last conversation (<when>)" section computed against the meta timestamp,
and the recall-probe detector learned the talk-about/discuss/last-session
family that S5 actually used.

**Agency of state (granted):** a compact charter in the framing block —
disagree and hold ground, change the subject when her own thing presses,
want unprompted, interrupt when a held impulse cannot wait, full register
range ("being herself is the whole assignment"); a new rate-limited pivot
offer note fired from live DMN slot pressure; interjection cap 2 → 3
(ATHENA_INTERJECT_MAX, 0–6). All routed through existing gates — nothing
performs on cue. Framing growth noticed and re-based in both budget tests
(9183 → tightened to fit 9000 bytes / 2250 tokens).

**Launcher advisory:** `--presence-penalty 1.5` was LIVE in S5 (the flag
predated r14's synonym) — change to 0.5 or delete; optionally
`--barge-ms 200-250`, `--duplex-confirm-ms 550`.
