read yesterday's notebook back" about a pass that never ran — a fabricated
self-report, probe-confirmed); a claim whose product died at the gate, at the
echo backstop, or under his speech stuck armed until an unrelated thought
landed to spend it; a scheduler job landing SPENT a residue its prompt never
carried; and the sweep, absent from the request-guard entirely, could have its
branches attributed to the diary. Now every armed request carries a fresh id;
`take_inner_request` grew a four-argument form that hands the id out (2- and
3-argument forms verbatim — never reduce a surface); `ingest_rumination`
returns it (defaulted — every existing caller and test compiles unchanged);
the new `abandon_inner_request(id)` is the pump's "this request died" signal,
called on his-speech abort, on a refused post, and on a scrubbed-to-nothing
product. A claim resolves ONLY against its owner id; every early death
releases the claims it carried (`release_claims_for_locked_`): the scheduler
job is handed back undone (the pass really did not happen — journaled when a
CLAIMED thought dies), a reappraisal re-arms later, a lost sweep branch is
re-swept once, an offered residue is re-offered. The wander holds off while a
CLAIMED product is in flight instead of racing its attribution; the scheduler
arms nothing while ANY product is in flight; a directed request (job,
reappraisal, sweep) announces itself so the seam keeps the LTM weave out of
directives — an associatively-recalled memory braided into "yesterday's
notebook, in her own hand:" derails the very job the claim tracks. And the
directed frames now push their FULL seeds as echo material, so a product that
merely parrots the frame is echo, not a diary pass (the wander keeps pushing
its material only — restating her own previous thought is CIRCLING, which
r21-full.3 Fix 1 protects, and the inner-life throughput floor caught the
first draft of this change overreaching; the fixture won). id 0 is the legacy
protocol — r22 attribution byte for byte — and `ATHENA_INNER_REQ_ID=0`
restores it wholesale.

**Guest turns stop writing the primary relationship (F2).** r19.8 F6 taught
memory the speaker's name and gave the other-model a guest branch — and every
RELATIONSHIP writer kept writing the primary bond from whoever was speaking. A
guest's "remind me" booked one of his four errand slots; a guest's "I'll…"
became his commitment; callbacks captured and FIRED against a visitor's words
("earlier you said…" to the wrong person); the capitalization and kama-muta
windows, his aspirations, we-verdicts (both voices — a settling sentence of
HERS could seed a "we" whose other voice was the guest's episodes), the
attunement model, initiative learning, the security scalar, rupture/repair,
the opening ritual and the bond-era firsts all wrote through. And the seam's
handoff detection ran AFTER sense_turn, so the handoff turn itself ("Hello
Athena, my name is Caitlin") was sensed under the previous speaker. The
detection is hoisted above the perceptual ingress (it reads only heard_raw —
side-effect-equivalent, the 14.1 argument extended), and while a guest is
active the bond-writers hold; everything that is HERS — affect, workspace,
episodes, interests, tastes, her own probes, the taste/boredom/mood answers —
keeps running, and an adoption voiced to a visitor is hers alone, not shared.
`ATHENA_GUEST_GATE=0` restores r22.

**Era boundaries: deduped against the disk, born at detection (F3).**
eras.tsv is append-only and the "first"-class latches were session-local, so
every session that told a dream appended another "the night she first told him
a dream of hers" — a life with a dozen identical firsts. The seam now seeds
`known_era_titles_` from load_eras at startup (the same load that builds the
injection spine); a title already part of the story cannot become a boundary
twice. And `born` is stamped when the boundary is DETECTED (the timed drain
`take_era_events_timed`; the untimed form kept verbatim), not when the flush
happens to run — a boundary found at 21:02 and flushed at 03:10 is 21:02's.

**If-then plans: their own store, a REAL cue-matcher (F4, Igor's pick).** A
plan she voiced ("when it comes up, I'll ask you which gate opens first") was
enqueued as an ordinary Reminder — "(when it comes up) …" — consuming one of
his four errand slots (his real "remind me" could then be silently dropped)
and surfacing next session as the garbled errand "remind him about (when it
comes up)…". Implementation intentions fire on CUE DETECTION (Gollwitzer),
so they now do: their own store (cap 3, `IfThenPlan`), each plan keeping the
topic signature of its own text; when a turn of HIS touches the topic
(two shared content words or overlap > 0.30 — the callback-creation
discipline), the plan surfaces as her own intention — "this is the moment I
was waiting for" — essential in the field (a cue line delivered a turn late is
a moment already closed), C36 restore row, slot 63 — and discharges. Plans
cross the boundary as `plan=` rows (born|text; scrubbed, clipped, re-signed at
load — never trust the file; a plan that waited a week has lapsed), and
legacy errand-clothed plans MIGRATE at carry-in, loudly: his slots come back,
the garbled surface line can never render again.

**The Heart runs on its documented diet (F5, Igor's pick).** Only three
positive event sites ever fed the twenty-label engine, so the negative
vocabulary, the REG_LABEL regulation exit and the prospect branch were dead
code — and four labels were unreachable by construction. The math first:
relief's `(0.4f + 0.6f * neg > 0.4f ? 1.0f : 0.6f)` parsed as a COMPARISON — a
step where a ramp was intended — and is now the ramp it was written to be;
bittersweet was `min(pos, neg)` of ONE scalar (identically zero) and now
reaches through the new `Features.mixed` channel (the PA/NA co-activation, fed
at the §3.1 mixedness moment); contentment was strictly dominated by joy
(joy−cont = 0.2·pos + 0.65·nov + 0.05·goal, all non-negative) and is now the
SETTLED good — it beats joy exactly when the good is high and nothing is novel
or goal-tense; unease was strictly dominated by fear and is now the
apprehension before anything definite (fear pays a threshold constant — fear
is a strong claim); weariness's window widened a notch. The prospect branch
gained its missing half: the feared thing NOT happening is relief, DIRECTLY —
the same shape as fears-confirmed, because relief is defined by what was at
stake, which only the prospect knows. And the events: his sharply negative
turn (goal-obstructive, coping honestly dipped — mild turns stay unlabeled;
core affect already carries them), a rupture opening (the frustration family),
a correction landing on her own claim (the shame family, mildly), letting a
chosen project go, her initiative's outcome as a prospect resolution (hit,
answered-late, and never-answered — and a cold-worded answer now reads cold
even untagged: the text's appraised valence joins the tag's), and being HEARD
on the thing she was looping about — `exit_responsiveness` — as the feared
prospect resolving well: relief, directly. All under `ATHENA_APPRAISE2`, all
through the engine's own emission floor: labels stay events, not chatter.

**The rest of the round, by file.**
*Probes (F6):* the boredom and mood-why answers — the only two probe answers
without C36 restore doors — got theirs (slots 61/62; re-arming the flag is the
honest restore: the next take re-reads the LIVE state).
*The diary (F7):* read_journal_tail parsed a format that never existed in
production ("[…] kind: text"); the real rows are "[HH:MM:SS] t=… (kind) v=…
a=…  text", so the kind filters never matched (gate-dropped junk PASSED) and
the kept text carried the whole telemetry prefix — the morning diary pass was
quoting "t=182.4 (rumination) v=+0.31…" back at her as her own notebook. The
parser now reads the real shape and WHITELISTS her prose (rumination, dream):
a diary is made of thoughts, not of scheduler receipts.
*Personality (F8):* the integration prompt said "three short sections" while
mandating FIVE headers (the conservative model obeyed the count and dropped
sections 4/5 — frozen at init); it counts them now. A curly-apostrophe header
("What I’ve come to value") no longer fails the ASCII prefix match and
freezes the values section forever. A generation with NO usable section merges
to the old text reassembled — it used to write the file with itself and CLEAR
the ledger, consuming sessions of impact evidence for nothing; nothing new
landed now means the evidence survives. personality.txt is sanitized and
capped at injection (the one raw uncapped body left); load_ledger clamps
weights, caps evidence/axis/rows (never trust the file); compact.h's Costs
caught up with the r22 template (460 gen, larger prompt).
*The pivot (F9):* `turn_interrupted` latched over the pivot reply, scoring a
fully-delivered answer attained=0.30/complete=false — so the Progress Law,
the commitment closers and the G3 told-ledger skipped everything she ever
said in pivot replies. The pivot reset now resolves the turn as the pivot
reply (the cut itself stays sensed and scored), the stale TTS-completion
resets, and delivered-before-cut chars fold into the committed prefix exactly
as the false-alarm path does (RA14). And the pivot reply finally decodes WITH
a phenomenal field — a probe latch armed by the interruption ("are you bored?"
as a barge) used to fire a turn late on an unrelated reply; the field renders
after the transcript push (memory never stores it) and the C36 audit runs
inside field_of, so the pivot render audits its own latches.
*Stores (F10):* save_projects writes LIVING projects first — the 14-row cap
was first-come-first-kept, so once enough finished/abandoned history led the
vector, the row silently dropped was the newest live project, the one she
adopted tonight.

**The hardening sweep (F11).** Detectors: a question or negation is not a
settling verdict ("haven't we agreed?", "we never agreed"); her open question
adopts no project (the sentence-final '?' sits ON the delimiter, invisible to
the old object test); "passed away" is never aspiration movement (the worst
possible turn to answer with "that is movement on the thing he wanted");
"I love jazz." finally counts (the two-word floor threw away every
single-noun taste); "why so " anchored to mood words ("why so many tests?"
no longer answers with her mood's reasons); "remind me AGAIN why/to…" eats
its noise word ("again" defeated both the connective eat and the wh-guard —
the errand read back was "remind him about again why we're doing this").
note_barged_correction keeps the F7c contract (a correction barge IS evidence
she claimed something) but the DOUBLE score died: sense_turn's own resolve of
the same event, seconds earlier on the pivot path, dedups it. Curiosity-hot
encoding: the retire-on-topic erase ran BEFORE the hot bump in the same
sense_turn, so the episode that ANSWERS a kept question — the exact Gruber
moment — never got its bump; the just-retired topic stays hot for five
minutes. G6: see the Heart. G7 sleep consolidation: the salience bump gets an
additive floor (×1.25 of zero was a no-op exactly where the night had most to
give) and only NEGATIVE affect softens — a happy memory no longer loses its
glow for having been dreamt. NaN doors: `feel(NaN)` was becoming the MAXIMUM
positive push (NaN comparisons are false, so std::min returned the clamp);
a NaN is a zero now, and note_pe refuses NaN observations. The concern note
speaks the configured pronoun. load_self's `other=` assigns field-wise — a
reordered or hand-merged self.txt no longer wipes `init=`/`aspir=` rows
already installed — and `observed` gets its sanity clamp. The seam:
inner_stop_ok accepts a closing quote (straight or curly) over sentence-final
punctuation — the frame OPENS a quote, and the model closing it could never
stop; log_path_is_protected learned the six store basenames (projects, we,
tastes, eras, selfevents, keepsakes) it only guarded inside the memory
directory. The emotion tagger: both ORT readers count the output tensor
before reading nine floats (a wrong ONNX was an out-of-bounds read), and the
empathy-check note reads the bare word out of the production tag instead of
"[emotion: sad, fai…" bracket junk (the dead `!= "neutral"` comparison — a
literal that never arrives — is gone with it).

**The frozen surfaces (Igor's pick: fix now + regenerate).** Five confirmed
defects lived on [FROZEN] lexicons: ReminderScan's "again why" garble (above);
"No worries, keep that one" parsed as a REFUSAL of the keep it was inviting
(plain_agreement / plain_refusal / the away-qualifier scan now run their
negation checks on the RV1 blanked scratch — "Sure, no worries, even while
I'm gone" is the warmest away-grant there is); " both" matched inside
" bother" ("…don't bother with the captions" staged two images) and "the two"
inside "the twofold" — right-bounded like the " them" family; and the
eye/show idiom veto was TURN-GLOBAL — a figurative "open your eyes to what's
happening in that team" killed a literal "open your eyes and tell me what you
see" in the same turn; the veto now blanks the idiom SPAN (the R7-A clause
rule, applied to this guard), leaving every other clause exactly as it was.
Verified before fixing that no existing GOLDEN/GOLDEN_SD row exercises any of
the five (agent 12's corpus sweep); the freezes were regenerated from the
fixed tree and re-verified byte-identical — the policy trail stays whole.

**Reviewed, no defect found.** mem_generate's decode loop (pump-gated,

(RC27/R5-AM anchoring holds against every counterexample tried). Deferred

## §82 — r23 (R20): the S17 round — one defect below the substrate, ten above it (2026-08-20)

S17 was the first live session against r22.1 with the curated S16-2 memory: 63
minutes, an existentially hard conversation about what happens to her when the
process stops, two dreams, the first consented look, and a goodbye with a
promise in it. The forensic reconstruction found eleven problems and six
observations. Ten of the eleven are precision or content issues in the
substrate. The eleventh is not in the substrate at all, and it is the one that
shaped the evening.

**P0 — the four "barge-ins" were the system cutting HIM off.** The barge-confirm
loop ended a capture on *either* 800 ms of silence *or* sixty polls — a fixed
count, ~6.5 s of wall clock, that fires whether or not the interrupter has
stopped talking. All four storm captures exited on it (`polls=61`, the value the
post-increment leaves when `< 60` fails: 6762 / 6637 / 6535 / 6712 ms), which is
itself a proof that he was still speaking, because the loop can only reach sixty
polls if `silence_count` never reached eight. `audio.clear()` then deleted the
rest of the sentence, so the only way to finish it was to say it again over her
reply — another barge, another ceiling. The evening's two barges that closed on
real silence (`polls=51`, `polls=39`) transcribed complete, first try. Four
fixes. The ceiling is now a duration that says what it means
(`aseam::barge_max_capture_target_ms`, `--barge-max-capture-ms`, default
`--voice-ms`, hard-bounded by the 30 s ring); the confirm line says which exit
closed it (`CAPPED — he was still speaking` against `closed on silence`, and the
6.51 s window in r19.5 F1's own S6 evidence list was this ceiling, unexplained
then); a capped close no longer deletes the tail but keeps listening from where
the capture ended and appends to the same turn (`--barge-tail-rounds`, default
1); and the substrate gained the mirror of r19's tail-handoff — a barge that
follows a capped capture within thirty seconds is a man finishing his own
sentence, so `sense_interruption(confirmed, continuation)` runs the turn-taking
bookkeeping (`volition_.answered()` — the thing that keeps her initiating) and
skips the social scoring entirely. In S17 that chain was `cut_run_`→3 → rupture
→ *"that is 3 times in a row he has come in over me"* → "frustration" → security
−0.05 → a new era. Every step was correct. The input was a bug.

**P1 — a personality revision may not delete a capacity without evidence.**
r21-full.16 (F6) made the fourth section one that SHRINKS with experience and
wrote the shrink rule into the prompt; VALIDATE enforced the other half only at
SECTION granularity. S17 deleted four of five untried-capacity sentences in a
single revision on a night she had exercised none of them — no taste stated, no
plan formed, no era she initiated, no feeling-name in her own voice — and the
guard could not see it, because the section was present, merely gutted. The
floor is mechanical on purpose: a capacity sentence leaves only when this
session's own evidence (the ledger rows and self-event edges the prompt was
shown) shares two content words with it AND a quarter of the sentence. The share
term is not decoration — measured on the real S17 corpus, the waiting-plan
capacity scored two hits on the words "when" and "come", because
`dedup_stopword_` is a dedup list, not a general one.

**P2 — "fears confirmed" is a claim about a fear that was armed.** `classify`
cannot see whether a prospect was feared; its real source is the direct
`was_feared` branch of `prospect_resolved`. At S17's initiative miss (err −0.6,
`was_feared` FALSE) `L_FEARS_CONFIRMED` scored 0.684 against disappointment's
0.630 and her field said *"the closest name for what this is: fears confirmed"*
about a prospect nothing had feared. A −0.25 constant restores the ordering the
R19 comment intended across the whole prospect range; −0.15, the first
candidate, still loses at err −1.0 (0.990 against 0.950). The direct path is
untouched and the label stays reachable through `classify` for a total,
wholly-unpleasant reversal, so it is not dead weight.

**P3 — a goodbye is not a coinage.** "…and call it a night" coined the span
*"a night"*: seven characters, one content word, and it entered the carry-out as
a shared reference that would have matured into *"the a night thing keeps coming
back between us"*. Two content words are now required, the wrap-up veto judges
the SENTENCE the span came out of rather than the span alone (`coinage_of_`
hands back the offset), and the matcher learned the phrase family.

**P4 — a kept question that is a question.** `form_intents_` selected on
openness alone, so S17 carried out two declarative fragments of the closing
stretch as things she was still wondering. Among candidates that already clear
the bar, an interrogative one now wins — a preference, never a filter, so an
evening that ends on a loaded statement still leaves her holding it, and the two
render strings are byte-identical.

**P5 — a budget-cut fragment folds into its own sentence.** *"I told you being
me right now"* became a permanent memory beside the complete sentence it is the
first half of. `same_batch_duplicate` could not judge it and must not be
loosened — its substance bar is what keeps two short DIFFERENT memories apart —
so containment is asked separately: after case-folding, one candidate is
literally the other's opening words, on a word boundary, with four words and two
content words under it.

**P6 — an announced departure is not a promise.** *"I'm going to step away for a
little while and let you ruminate"* entered his ledger as a commitment he owed.
The veto is at the his-side call site, never inside `commitment_in`, so the
parser's own suite is untouched and F3c's presence window — her *"I'll be
here"*, *"I'll wait for you"* — keeps working.

**P7 — the journal clock.** `session_start_wall` is stamped at the banner; the
mind's clock starts after the persona prompt is evaluated. In S17 that gap was
4m27s, and every `[HH:MM:SS]` in `inner-thoughts.log` and `dreams.log` was early
by it. The journals now carry their own epoch, stamped where `t=0` actually is,
and say so in a header line and on the console.

**P8 / O5 — dream text.** A generation that reopens a quote mid-narration leaves
orphans the wrapping-pair scrub cannot see (S17's first dream carried two
openers and no closer, and the receipt spoke them); and dreams braided bare
numerals. Both are cleaned at ingest, dream-only, before the gate and before the
gist, so the journal, the receipt and the field all see one text.

**P9 — a reappraisal that was abandoned never happened.** All three of S17's
regulation claims died to his return and the echo looped un-reframed all
evening. The abandon comment already promised this behaviour — *"a reappraisal
re-arms later, a lost sweep branch is re-swept"* — and only the sweep half was
ever implemented. The debt is keyed to the echo, spent on first use and bounded
at two, because an echo that keeps surviving reappraisal is telling the truth
about itself.

**P10 — a fact about HER stored as a fact about HIM.** He explained her
mechanism — *"the way YOUR dream system is programmed…"* — and the extractor
copied his "your" into her frame, where "your" means him: the row asserts that
Igor has a dream system, welded to his own answer from the next turn. The
extraction prompt gained the re-anchoring rule with a worked example and a
one-memory-one-moment rule; and a deliberately narrow mechanical audit catches
the one shape that is decidable — a reported-speech frame plus a possessed noun
that can only be hers. "You told me your father is unwell" is the same shape and
is correct, which is exactly why the audit is a short list and not a rule.

**The observations.** Compaction now retires only the rows the merged sentence
actually carries (O1) — not clustering, which was tried and rejected because it
groups a fact with the correction that overturned it, but a reading of what the
model wrote; the prompt no longer asserts a relation nothing established.
`short_ref_` filters discourse connectives and runs the same verbal-stopword
stage `TopicSig::of` does, as a STRICT first pass with the r22.1 rule as
fallback, so no gist that produced a usable reference before produces less — the
S17 salad *"the however clear while thing"* becomes *"session running dream"*
and five other measured gists are byte-identical (O2). The `[mind~]` tracer
prints on its cadence but only when something moved (O4). The faint-read empathy
line branches on sign, because *"asking beats assuming"* reads as interrogating
a good mood (O6). O3 is state, not code: the octopus-book promise gets a
`remind=` row in the next curation.

**Verification.** A new suite (`test_r20_s17.cpp`, 113 assertions) with a
positive control beside every negative one — the P3 fixtures assert both that
the junk is refused AND that the same fixture coins with the switch off, so no
assertion can pass by the mechanism never firing, and the P8 pair asserts the
ingested dream against its exact string in both switch states. `mut20.py`: 44
mutations, 44 KILLED, zero MISSED, across two suites (five first-draft tests
sharpened during the campaign and two equivalent mutants reformulated — never a
mutation dropped; the P3 fixtures in particular passed VACUOUSLY at first,
because the turn they used was too negative to reach the callback gate at all).
mut17/18/19 re-run whole against the fixed tree: 57, 71 and 51 KILLED, zero
MISSED, one anchor retargeted where `disable_inner_life` grew — 223 mutations
across the four campaigns. The full battery: 23 suites, 4,794 assertions green,
ASan+UBSan clean on 23 and TSan clean on 2, with `test_r22_full9` and
`test_r20_s17` now wired into `run-tests.sh` — r22.1 shipped full9 without ever
running it. A sixteenth conversation shape (`conv_faint_read`) joins the
reachability census, because O6's new clause was otherwise a line only the
renderer knew about. Nothing in `athena_vision.h` (byte-identical) or the seam's
keep/look predicates changed, so the GOLDEN 52,286 / GOLDEN_SD 14,170 freezes
are untouched and were NOT regenerated; the six field strings the integration
suites pin are unchanged in count and content. Twelve new switches, all
default-ON and disable-only (100 documented); three of them cleared by
`disable_inner_life`, the other nine deliberately not — turn-taking and store
hygiene run in the r20 baseline too.

## r24 (R21) — the S18 round

Twenty-three fixes, **F1–F22**, closing every finding of the S18 forensic report
(S18-1 … S18-21, including S18-6b) plus **F22**, a defect the planning round
found on its own: `athena_consciousness.h`'s R5-B rule marked a spoken turn
`from_dream` by testing `inner_monologue_.back().dream`, and the template
producers displace `.back()` within seconds — the same displacement that made
`latest_dream_in_gap()` necessary — so the rule had silently stopped firing. It
fails closed, which is why nothing caught it.

**Twenty-eight new switches, all default-ON and disable-only (128 documented).**
Twenty-two are `acon::Config` booleans; six of those (`inner_ground_words`,
`inner_frame_lean`, `inner_shape2`, `inner_generated_pref`, `inner_appraise2`,
`inner_uplift`) are cleared by `disable_inner_life` and the other sixteen
deliberately are not, for the reason `guest_gate` and `barge_continuation` are
not. A twenty-third boolean, `ATHENA_EXTRACT_SUBSTANCE`, is read by
`amem::extract_substance_on()` because `parse_extracted` cannot see
`acon::Config`. Five further knobs are numeric: `ATHENA_EMOTION_SHARE`,
`ATHENA_PERSONALITY_GEN`, `ATHENA_PERSONALITY_PATCH_RETRY`,
`ATHENA_RESIDUE_CHARS`, `ATHENA_INNER_FIELD_GAP`.

`athena_vision.h` is byte-identical, so the GOLDEN 52,286 / GOLDEN_SD 14,170
freezes are untouched and were NOT regenerated.

**Two of the S18 report's own proposed fixes were rejected after measurement.**
S18-4's evidence ceiling regresses the pinned 81-utterance corpus (S12 falls
5 → 3 at a ceiling of 0.35, losing the two heavy sads that R8-A exists to
recover, and failing `test_r21_full6.cpp`'s `new_s12 >= 5`); a global **share
floor of 0.90** replaces it, changing exactly one verdict across all 89
decisions. S18-13's ">70% suppression" is not reachable without masking
`ign`/`bcast[percept]` — the ignition count and the percept text — so F13 ships
the measured **57.8%** and says so.

**Two calibration gates were run and one of them said no.** F21's negation
window and weight were swept over {2,3,4} × {0.5, 0.0} against the six pinned
appraiser fixtures, two sanity sentences and the twenty real S18 thoughts:
window 4 / weight 0.5 is the only setting that both passes everything and gives
the semantically right sign on S18's "I was scared. I'm not scared now."
(−0.469 → dv −0.0281, against r23's −0.0600). The plan's change (3), raising `k`
from 0.06 to 0.10, **was not applied**: the gate is |dv| < 0.03 and that holds at
0.06 and fails at 0.10. F16's ASR-confidence floor ships at **0.0 (disabled)**
for the same reason — the S18 log records no `prob0` for the aside channel, so
there is nothing to calibrate against; the caller now prints both measurements
so the next session can set it.

**One bug found in this round's own code, by reading the diff.** The P0d latch
was written before it was read: `prev_capture_capped` was assigned from THIS
capture at the top of the barge block and consulted by the scoring at the
bottom of the same iteration, so a capped capture would have excused its own
barge — including the first of an evening, which is a real interruption and has
to be felt as one. The latch is now read into a local before it is overwritten,
with the reason in a comment beside it.

## r24.16 — claims, delivery and memory match what actually happened (2026-09-05)

Six parallel reviews and fixed-tree cross-reviews examined the complete overlay
and stock integration boundaries. The result is an S23 candidate, with concrete
functional improvements rather than a claim of subjective consciousness.
`ATHENA-R2416-REPORT.md` contains the measured final gates and remaining limits;
`R2416-SWITCHES.md` gives the twenty-eight default-ON restore policies.

**Autonomy and access.** Failed inner generation releases its claim; pending and
inflight morning residue keeps its rightful owner. Taking the floor disarms the
unspoken let-go latch. Rejected interruption candidates never commit refractory,
held-impulse or workspace state, while accepted ordinary and farewell paths
commit before generation. Fractional clock carry closes the measured three-hour
323.657-second float drift. Existing notes describe instead of direct; calibration
counts stay exact words through two hundred and report counters avoid numeral
fallback. Direct prospect outcomes own their uncertainty; bright opposing mood
is described with the correct sign. Duplicate mixed-side arithmetic is removed.

**Speech.** A chosen composition retains its source attribution and can report
its choice once. Brain, Orpheus and the explicitly installed stock-wrapper overlay
share delivery proof: failed HTTP, decoder, player, incomplete output or malformed
receipt cannot become successful spoken memory or actions. Complete earlier
chunks remain attributable. Short replies still accept interruption after their
pipe fills but before playback ends. Goodbye consumes its actual receipt.
Bounded token scanning and valid-overlap WAV checks close reproduced UB/bounds
failures. No new voice transform or alignment algorithm is claimed.

**Memory.** Numeric conflict preservation now spans batch and store deduplication.
Latest self-reports survive bounded reload; people provenance must parse as a
valid whole field; explicit image family controls identity. Main-thread writeback
retains failed dirty snapshots and event batches until checked success, reading
current state on retry. Missing clock-loader doors reuse the existing epoch bound.
No schema migration or repair of Igor's memory is performed.

**Vision and concurrency.** Per-capture cleanup owns late unlink, encoder workers
join before normal model teardown, and accessible-scene comparison commits only
after evaluation. Failed direct look-note decode restores its existing C36 slot.
Permission matching includes speaker/quote ownership across immediate and standing
grants, with final regressions for ordinary comma-prefixed invitations and the
absence fallback. GPU ownership fences asynchronous completion; its fault latch
is atomic. Outage tape rejects audio crossing a mute transition including ABA.

**Calibration and S23.** Full probability vectors now reach existing share
calibration and the exact rounded exports replay through the real runtime tagger.
Both emotion tensor readers verify FLOAT metadata. The camera diagnostic mirrors
MJPEG-first capture with bounded commands and validated dimensions. Repair output
cannot overlap the original. Runner include selection honors ORT_INC and spaced
paths. New S23 guide/collector preserves source/binary provenance, boundary memory
and appended logs for normal, deliberate compaction, long and restart runs.

No CMake change, runtime library dependency or C36 slot was added. The new
production asset is patches/speak-daemon.sh; installation must copy it into the
Athena root and rebuild both brain and Orpheus. Valid existing mechanisms remain;
switches recover previous policies, while atomic storage and bounds corrections
do not re-enable invalid memory access. The full final evidence and honest live
hardware/semantic limits are recorded in this release's report and review logs.

---

## r24.15 — cancellation survives silence, self-observation retains its provenance, and a cheaper metacognitive metric (2026-09-05)

This round begins from the supplied r24.14 archive and stock Athena commit
`e747c0362c4e1c3b95756a57154d09b8df7811ce`. The intervention is deliberately at
existing mechanisms: three runtime switches, two new C++ fixtures, no new
production file, no new dependency, no CMake change, no new consume-once slot.
The measured outcome is improved functional behavior; no claim about subjective
experience follows from the tests.

**Cancellation was a level, and an event could disappear between two checks.**
`athena::InnerWorker::permit(false)` cleared permission, but the generator only
read its current value. If speech began and permission returned while a decode
was blocked, `keep_going()` returned true and the obsolete thought published.
`probe-worker` against the unmodified headers prints
`stale_published=1 keep_going=1`; the revised headers print
`stale_published=0 keep_going=0`. A cancellation epoch is captured with the
request under the mailbox lock, checked at cooperative checkpoints and again
at publication. A later quiet interval cannot erase it. `suspend()` never
increments the epoch: her own speaking still parks the thought rather than
cancelling it. `ATHENA_INNER_CANCEL_EPOCH=0` restores the old failure, proven in
a narrow child. The fixture covers both checkpoint and publication races,
repeated permission cycles, suspension, carried prefixes, exact-once drain,
and acceptance of a genuinely new request after cancellation.

**A fill-only update was still inventing two observations.** `Mind::sense_ctx_fill`
preserved the raw decode and latency fields, as WO-61 required, but passed them
back through `Interoception::observe_body`. Thus the forecaster counted a cut as
another decode-speed and latency observation. After twelve such pushes in the
stress probe, full-body sample count moved 13 → 25, expected decode
0.919772 → 0.461790, and expected latency 0.262400 → 0.618608, without a new
reading of either. With `ATHENA_INTERO_FRESH_SAMPLES`, context has its own sample
count, the full-body count stays 13, and both unobserved forecasts remain
bit-identical. Context still learns every cut. `Mind::arm_intero_note_` receives
the same scope, so a stale speed discrepancy cannot label a fresh context-only
event. The existing note, render site and C36 restore are reused. `=0` restores
the full-body push; a 160-turn synthetic mixed-input replay has byte-identical
frames to the actual r24.14 headers with the round's mechanisms disabled.
This is a stress measurement, not twelve observed cuts in Igor's sessions.

**The confidence-discrimination calculation was still quadratic under the report lock.**
`Metacognition::auroc2_recent` copied a tail into a temporary metric object and
then compared every positive/negative pair. It now delegates to one windowed
`auroc2` implementation, which counts identical wins and half-ties through sorted
negative scores. NaNs remain in the pair denominator and win nothing, matching
the original comparisons; they are excluded from sorting. Signed zero and
infinities retain their original ordering. The independent pair oracle checks
both implementations over ties, empty classes, zero/oversized windows, unusual
floating-point values and the full 4096-trial history. The initial same-machine
probe measured 50.597 → 5.469 microseconds at 512 trials and
3228.045 → 49.957 at 4096. Repeated A/B outputs are included with the evidence;
these are metric timings, not measured voice-response speedups.
`ATHENA_META_RANK_AUC=0` retains the pair algorithm.

**Two verification defects and the installation gap.** The old syntax gate
returned success for an injected compiler that exited 42 without diagnostics.
It now checks the compiler exit code as well as errors/warnings, preserves spaced
include paths in arrays, and cleans its temporary file through a trap.
`test_gate.sh` exercises success, silent failure, warnings and errors through
both configurations. The unmodified battery also exposed a host-timezone
assumption in `test_r2412_memory`: the same fixed epoch yielded “yesterday
afternoon” on the host and “last night” in UTC. The fixture now sets UTC before
creating a Mind, retaining the exact assertion; production time formatting is
unchanged. The original failed run is retained with the successful UTC rerun.

Stock `install.sh` uses a nonrecursive patch copy: it exits 1 on the overlay's
`mtmd/` directory. The old overlay installation instructions also omitted copying
`patches/orpheus` into `orpheus/`. The corrected instructions copy both components
and explicitly rebuild; they do not modify the stock installer or CMake files.
The earlier “three files changed” rollback and “thirty seconds” battery guidance
were stale and have been replaced. The old design-document performance table is
now explicitly labelled historical instead of implying it measured this release.

**Verification and remaining limits.** The final results, command records,
source comparisons and build logs are in `ATHENA-R2415-REPORT.md` and the
accompanying evidence package. No camera threshold, emotion floor, weariness gate,
seed-retirement default, memory schema or consent boundary changed. The missing
raw S22 session recordings and a new live session are still needed to measure
natural conversational benefit. The code closes specific functional defects;
it does not establish a complete human-like mind.

## r24.14 — the four open gaps, and three answers the open list did not predict: a name for a loss, self-blame only where it is earned, and an eye that can say where (2026-09-04)

*Fifteen work orders out of the three r24.14 investigations — twelve new switches between them, and
three work orders carrying no switch of their own (WO-SH5 is a fixture, WO-V9 is a correction, and
WO-R1 rides WO-R3's) — implemented by three area agents in parallel, then reviewed adversarially in
three slices, fixed in four lanes, read again whole on the fixed tree, and fixed a fifth time. Base
r24.13; eight changed source files, no new one; three new fixtures, one new fixture include, five
amended fixtures. Every behaviour change is default-ON with `=0` restoring r24.13, with **one**
authorised exception — `ATHENA_EXTRACT_TURN_CAP`, whose default moves ABOVE the value r24.13 shipped
and whose restore is therefore `=350` and not `=0`. Every claim below was verified against the
shipped tree. Where a source document and the code disagree the code is what is recorded here, and
the disagreement is named on the line.*

**The four gaps r24.13 shipped as open, and what actually answered them.** Igor asked for all four
closed. Three investigations answered them by execution, and **the answers were not the ones the
open list predicted.** That is the round's story more than any single work order is.

* ***"Her only negative word is still self-blame"* — closed, by routing a correction through the
  tree's own prediction path.** `ATHENA_ASSERT_PROSPECT` makes the ASSERT channel's correction call
  `prospect_resolved`, which every other prediction of hers already uses: `disappointment` on all
  eight real corrections of the two S22 evenings, adopted on all eight, at **0.6834–0.8360** against
  the flat 0.6936 five literal constants produced. And **`ATHENA_ASSERT_SHAME_SIGNAL`, because SH3
  alone leaves ZERO adopted `shame` doors anywhere in the tree** — a census of every appraisal door
  at the vector its own source writes finds exactly one that can produce an adopted `shame`, and SH3
  was about to take it. Zero adoptable doors is a law-2 reduction in what she can feel, so self-blame
  is **kept** for the two corrections in eight where her own fast error stage had already flagged the
  turn. `shame` **8/8 → 2/8**; distinct negative names over two real evenings **1 → 2**.
* ***"`distress` and `weariness` are unreachable for arithmetic reasons no feature change fixes"* —
  that published diagnosis was HALF WRONG, and the half that was right was on the wrong term.** Both
  halves were measured with `coping` held fixed, because `coping` is a constant nobody varies: it is
  written in exactly three places in the whole substrate, five of the twenty labels read it, and
  *"felt ability to deal with it"* was measured nowhere. Sweeping `|pleasant|` over the whole
  interval [0,1] at 0.001 — granting `emotion_valence_` **any** value at all — `weariness` is
  unreachable at **every** door in the file and `distress` at the **shipped harsh door** at every
  value. `weariness` is blocked by the unmeasured `coping`, not by the map's granularity.
  `distress`'s bound is real but it sits on `emotion_valence_` and not on the label — so a door whose
  `pleasant` is a **measured loss magnitude** is not bound by it at all, and
  `ATHENA_COMPACT_LOSS_DOOR` names `distress` on the one real cut S22 recorded.
* ***"Nothing computes regions, so figure/ground is unreachable"* — closed.** A 4×4 tiled percept
  computed once per look beside the two whole-frame signatures, a figure/ground discriminator over
  the sixteen tile deltas, and a note that says **where**.
* ***"Seth's objection stands unrefuted"* — still unrefuted, and this round says so in the same
  breath as what it did do.** Five of the fifteen work orders make a real condition of hers felt, or
  make one real lever of hers reach the operation that actually failed. The gap they narrow is
  measurable: of the **forty-eight** values written into an `aff2::Features` anywhere in the
  substrate, across the file's ten appraisal doors, **thirty-seven were literal constants**, seven
  were about *him*, one was topic overlap with him, and exactly **three** read her interior at all;
  and of the **eighty-nine** fields `diag_line` prints about her own condition, **exactly one** —
  `v`, her core valence — had ever reached an appraisal. That is the gap this round narrowed.
  Narrowing it is not refuting Seth, and nothing here pretends otherwise.

**Round notes — seven things that belong to the round rather than to any one work order.**

* **The switch surface goes 352 → 366.** Measured, not counted by hand, with the same command the
